groups.definition_en: smooth and even; without marked lumps or indentations
groups.notes: 可指表面平滑、地面无坡、地势平坦；地球的语境指平的。
groups.evidence: “trim the surface … completely flat”和“flat countryside”分别体现表面平滑与地势平坦；“the earth is flat”用作形容词，表示平的。

examples.sentence: trim the surface of the cake to make it completely flat.
examples.translation_cn: 把蛋糕表面修整平滑。

examples.sentence: thirty-five acres of flat countryside.
examples.translation_cn: 三十五英亩平坦的乡间土地。

examples.sentence: the flat roof of a garage.
examples.translation_cn: 车库的平屋顶。

examples.sentence: Of course, no one now believes that the earth is flat.
examples.translation_cn: 当然如今无人相信地球是平的。

examples.sentence: a perfect, flat lawn.
examples.translation_cn: 十分平坦的草坪

examples.sentence: as flat as a pancake.
examples.translation_cn: 完全平的

examples.sentence: the sea was flat and there was no wind.
examples.translation_cn: 海上风平浪静

groups.definition_en: having a broad level surface but little height or depth; shallow
groups.notes: 指厚度或深度较小、不呈圆形；可描述盒子、锅底或身体部位。
groups.evidence: “a flat rectangular box”和“a pan with a flat base”描述宽而浅或平的形状；“slim hips and a flat stomach”也表示扁平。

examples.sentence: a flat rectangular box.
examples.translation_cn: 一个扁平的长方形盒子。

examples.sentence: a pan with a flat base.
examples.translation_cn: 平底锅

examples.sentence: slim hips and a flat stomach.
examples.translation_cn: 窄臀平腹

examples.sentence: some early scientists believed that the earth was flat.
examples.translation_cn: 早期的一些科学家认为地球是平的

groups.definition_en: lacking interest or emotion; dull and lifeless
groups.notes: 用于声音、画作或颜色时，指缺少生气、情感或层次；颜色语境也可强调单一、缺少反差。
groups.evidence: “her drawings were flat and unimaginative”体现缺乏生气；“a flat shade of grey”及“his voice was flat and monotonous”体现颜色单调、声音平板。

examples.sentence: her drawings were flat and unimaginative.
examples.translation_cn: 她的画作平淡乏味，缺乏想象力。

examples.sentence: “I'm sorry,” he said, in a flat voice.
examples.translation_cn: “对不起，”他用平淡的语气说道。

examples.sentence: the dress was a deadly, flat shade of gray.
examples.translation_cn: 这条裙子是毫无生气的纯灰色。

examples.sentence: a flat shade of grey.
examples.translation_cn: 单调的灰色

examples.sentence: his voice was flat and monotonous.
examples.translation_cn: 他的声音平板而单调

examples.sentence: ‘she's dead,’ he said in a flat voice.
examples.translation_cn: “她死了，”他淡淡地说

groups.definition_en: (of a person) without energy; dispirited
groups.notes: 指人缺乏精力、情绪低落。
groups.evidence: “he felt flat and weary”中flat描述人的精神状态。

examples.sentence: his sense of intoxication wore off until he felt flat and weary.
examples.translation_cn: 醉意渐渐消退，他感到无精打采、疲惫不堪。

groups.definition_en: (of a market, prices, etc.) showing little activity; sluggish
groups.notes: 用于市场、价格或销售等，指活动或增长乏力。
groups.evidence: “flat sales in the drinks industry”及“cash flow was flat”表示销售或现金流缺少增长和活力。

examples.sentence: cash flow was flat at $214 million.
examples.translation_cn: 现金流维持在2.14亿美元，没有增长。

examples.sentence: flat sales in the drinks industry.
examples.translation_cn: 饮料行业的销售表现低迷。

groups.definition_en: (of something kept inflated, especially a tire) having lost some or all of its air, typically because of a puncture
groups.notes: 轮胎等充气物失去部分或全部空气；电池flat则指电量耗尽。
groups.evidence: “you've got a flat tire”和“my back tyre has gone flat”表示轮胎没气。

examples.sentence: you've got a flat tire.
examples.translation_cn: 你的轮胎瘪了。

examples.sentence: my back tyre has gone flat.
examples.translation_cn: 我的后胎瘪了

examples.sentence: you've got a flat tyre.
examples.translation_cn: 你有一个轮胎没气了

groups.definition_en: (of a denial, contradiction, or refusal) completely definite and firm; absolute
groups.notes: 用于否认、拒绝等时，表示坚决、明确、没有商量余地。
groups.evidence: “a flat denial”及“He gave me a flat refusal”表明该形容词强调明确坚决。

examples.sentence: his statement was a flat denial that he had misbehaved.
examples.translation_cn: 他断然否认自己有过不当行为。

examples.sentence: He gave me a flat refusal.
examples.translation_cn: 他断然拒绝了我。

examples.sentence: she gave me a flat rejection.
examples.translation_cn: 她断然拒绝了我

examples.sentence: you're not going to the party, and that's flat!
examples.translation_cn: 你不能去参加聚会，没有商量余地！

groups.definition_en: pressed close
groups.notes: 与表面紧密接触。
groups.evidence: “flat against the wall”及“feet flat on the floor”说明形容词flat表示紧贴表面。

examples.sentence: is the wardrobe flat against the wall?
examples.translation_cn: 衣柜贴住墙了吗？

examples.sentence: with one's feet flat on the floor.
examples.translation_cn: 双脚紧贴地板

groups.notes: 描述鞋跟很低或没有鞋跟。
groups.evidence: “sandals with flat heels”中flat修饰heels，表示平跟。

examples.sentence: a pair of sandals with flat heels.
examples.translation_cn: 一双平跟凉鞋

groups.notes: 用于电池时表示电量耗尽。
groups.evidence: “the battery must be flat”中flat描述电池电量耗尽。

examples.sentence: the battery must be flat.
examples.translation_cn: 电池肯定没电了

groups.notes: 指费用或费率不随数量或使用情况变化。
groups.evidence: “a flat fee”及“a flat rate for every telephone call”表示费用固定。

examples.sentence: I did the work for a flat fee.
examples.translation_cn: 我做这个工作酬劳固定

examples.sentence: We pay a flat rate for every telephone call.
examples.translation_cn: 我们打电话每次付相同的费用。

examples.sentence: a flat fare of £1.50.
examples.translation_cn: 车费一律1.5英镑

groups.definition_en: in or to a horizontal position
groups.notes: 可指身体处于水平姿势，也可指把物体弄平、击倒或夷平。
groups.evidence: “lying flat on his back”中flat修饰躺卧姿势；“hammered the metal flat”中表示使金属变平。

examples.sentence: he was lying flat on his back.
examples.translation_cn: 他仰面平躺着。

examples.sentence: she had been knocked flat by the blast.
examples.translation_cn: 爆炸把她震倒在地。

examples.sentence: Lie down flat and breathe deeply.
examples.translation_cn: 平躺下，作深呼吸。

examples.sentence: she hammered the metal flat.
examples.translation_cn: 她把金属锤平

examples.sentence: she knocked her opponent flat.
examples.translation_cn: 她将对手击倒在地

examples.sentence: the bombing raid laid the village flat.
examples.translation_cn: 空袭将这个村庄夷为平地

examples.sentence: the pleats should lie flat after you have pressed them.
examples.translation_cn: 熨烫过后这些衣褶应该很伏贴

groups.definition_en: lying in close juxtaposition, especially against another surface
groups.evidence: “hair was blown flat across his skull”及“I pressed flat against the wall”表示紧贴表面。

examples.sentence: his black curly hair was blown flat across his skull.
examples.translation_cn: 他的黑色卷发被风吹得紧贴头皮。

examples.sentence: I pressed flat against the wall.
examples.translation_cn: 我紧靠在墙上

groups.definition_en: so as to become smooth and even
groups.notes: 表示使物体变得平滑、平整。
groups.evidence: “I hammered the metal flat”中flat表示锤至平整。

examples.sentence: I hammered the metal flat.
examples.translation_cn: 我把金属锤平了。

groups.definition_en: completely; absolutely
groups.notes: 表示完全、坚决；用于告知或拒绝时也可指直截了当。
groups.evidence: “turning you down flat”表示断然拒绝；“told me flat”表示直截了当地告知。

examples.sentence: : she was going to be flat broke in a couple of days.
examples.translation_cn: 她过几天就会身无分文。

examples.sentence: I'm turning you down flat.
examples.translation_cn: 我断然拒绝你。

examples.sentence: she told me flat that I hadn't got the job.
examples.translation_cn: 她直截了当地告诉我说我没有得到这份工作

groups.definition_en: after a phrase expressing a period of time to emphasize how quickly something can be done or has been done
groups.notes: 置于时间长度后，强调事情恰在该时长内完成，常含迅速之意。
groups.evidence: “ten minutes flat”及“in five seconds flat”都以flat强调时长恰好为十分钟、五秒。

examples.sentence: you can prepare a healthy meal in ten minutes flat.
examples.translation_cn: 只要十分钟就能做好一顿健康的饭。

examples.sentence: she drank the beer in five seconds flat.
examples.translation_cn: 她仅仅5秒钟就喝完了啤酒

groups.definition_en: below the true or normal pitch of musical sound
groups.notes: 用于音乐，指音高偏低。
groups.evidence: “singing flat”与唱错音相对，说明flat指音准偏低。

examples.sentence: it wasn't a question of singing flat, but of simply singing the wrong notes.
examples.translation_cn: 问题不在于唱得偏低，而在于唱错了音。

groups.definition_en: the flat part of something
groups.notes: 指手掌、刀刃、桨等物体的平坦部分。
groups.evidence: “the flat of my hand”及“the flat of a sword”分别指手掌和剑的平面部分。

examples.sentence: she placed the flat of her hand over her glass.
examples.translation_cn: 她把手掌覆在自己的杯子上。

examples.sentence: I hit the table with the flat of my hand.
examples.translation_cn: 我用手掌击桌。

examples.sentence: he struck her with the flat of his hand.
examples.translation_cn: 他扇了她一巴掌

examples.sentence: the flat of a sword.
examples.translation_cn: 剑面

groups.definition_en: an area of low level ground, especially near water.
groups.notes: 指水边或潮间带的大片平坦低地。
groups.evidence: “the Utah salt flats”及“dug clams in the flats at low tide”指平坦低地或潮滩。

examples.sentence: the Utah salt flats.
examples.translation_cn: 犹他州的盐滩。

examples.sentence: We dug clams in the flats at low tide.
examples.translation_cn: 退潮时我们在浅滩挖蛤蜊。

groups.definition_en: a shoe with a very low heel or no heel
groups.evidence: “a pair of … flats”中flats指平跟或无跟鞋。

examples.sentence: she wore a white strapless dress and a pair of electric blue flats.
examples.translation_cn: 她穿着一条无肩带白裙，脚踩一双亮蓝色平跟鞋。

groups.definition_en: a flat tire
groups.evidence: “I've got a flat”指轮胎漏气、瘪了。

examples.sentence: I've got a flat—there were nails under the wheel.
examples.translation_cn: 我的轮胎瘪了——车轮下面有钉子。

groups.definition_en: lower (a note) by a semitone
groups.notes: 音乐术语。
groups.evidence: “he will flat and sharp”中flat与sharp并列，表示将音降低半音。

examples.sentence: when a person has a poor ear for music, he will flat and sharp right along without knowing it.
examples.translation_cn: 一个人如果乐感差，就会不知不觉地把音唱低或唱高。

groups.definition_en: make flat; flatten
groups.evidence: “flat the loaves down”表示把面包压平。

examples.sentence: flat the loaves down.
examples.translation_cn: 把面包压扁。

groups.notes: 英式英语中常用flat指一套住宅。
groups.evidence: “a block of flats”及“a flat on the top floor”都指公寓住宅。

examples.sentence: a block of flats.
examples.translation_cn: 公寓楼

examples.sentence: a flat on the top floor.
examples.translation_cn: 顶楼的一套公寓

senses.definition_en: the distinctive taste of a food or drink

examples.sentence: adding sun-dried tomatoes gives the sauce extra flavor.
examples.translation_cn: 加入日晒番茄会让酱汁风味更浓。

examples.sentence: the yoghurt comes in eight fruit flavors.
examples.translation_cn: 这种酸奶有八种水果风味。

senses.definition_en: the general quality of taste in a food

examples.sentence: no other cracker adds so much flavor to the cheese.
examples.translation_cn: 没有别的饼干能给奶酪增添如此多的风味。

senses.definition_en: a substance used to alter or enhance the taste of food or drink; a flavoring

examples.sentence: we use vanilla and almond flavors.
examples.translation_cn: 我们使用香草和杏仁调味料。

senses.definition_en: an indication of the essential character of something

examples.sentence: the extracts give a flavor of the content and tone of the conversation.
examples.translation_cn: 这些摘录体现了谈话的内容和语气。

senses.definition_en: a distinctive quality or atmosphere

examples.sentence: whitewashed walls and red pantiles gave the resort a Mediterranean flavor.
examples.translation_cn: 粉刷成白色的墙壁和红色瓦片让度假胜地充满地中海特色。

senses.definition_en: a kind, variety, or sort

examples.sentence: various flavors of firewall are evolving.
examples.translation_cn: 防火墙的各种类型正在不断发展。

senses.definition_en: alter or enhance the taste of (food or drink) by adding a particular ingredient

examples.sentence: chunks of chicken flavored with herbs.
examples.translation_cn: 用香草调味的鸡肉块。

examples.sentence: they use a wide range of spices to flavor their foods.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用各种香料为食物调味。

senses.definition_en: give a distinctive quality to

examples.sentence: the faint exasperation that had flavored her tone.
examples.translation_cn: 她的语气中带着一丝不耐烦。

groups.definition_en: the distinctive taste of a food or drink
groups.notes: 既可指某种食物或饮料独特的味道，也可泛指其总体味道；可用于不同口味的种类。
groups.evidence: 例句1说晒干番茄使酱汁风味更浓，例句2说酸奶有八种水果口味，例句3说饼干给奶酪增添风味，均指食物的味道。

examples.sentence: adding sun-dried tomatoes gives the sauce extra flavor.
examples.translation_cn: 加入日晒番茄会让酱汁风味更浓。

examples.sentence: the yoghurt comes in eight fruit flavors.
examples.translation_cn: 这种酸奶有八种水果风味。

examples.sentence: no other cracker adds so much flavor to the cheese.
examples.translation_cn: 没有别的饼干能给奶酪增添如此多的风味。

groups.definition_en: a substance used to alter or enhance the taste of food or drink; a flavoring
groups.notes: 指用于改变或增强食物、饮料味道的成分。
groups.evidence: 例句4中的香草和杏仁 flavors 是用于调味的成分。

examples.sentence: we use vanilla and almond flavors.
examples.translation_cn: 我们使用香草和杏仁调味料。

groups.definition_en: a distinctive quality or atmosphere
groups.notes: 可指对某事物本质的体现，也可指鲜明的氛围或特色。
groups.evidence: 例句5说摘录体现谈话的内容和语气，例句6说墙面和瓦片赋予度假胜地地中海特色，均指事物显现出的特质。

examples.sentence: the extracts give a flavor of the content and tone of the conversation.
examples.translation_cn: 这些摘录体现了谈话的内容和语气。

examples.sentence: whitewashed walls and red pantiles gave the resort a Mediterranean flavor.
examples.translation_cn: 粉刷成白色的墙壁和红色瓦片让度假胜地充满地中海特色。

groups.definition_en: a kind, variety, or sort
groups.notes: 用于比喻不同类别或变体。
groups.evidence: 例句7中的 firewall flavors 指防火墙的不同类型。

examples.sentence: various flavors of firewall are evolving.
examples.translation_cn: 防火墙的各种类型正在不断发展。

groups.definition_en: alter or enhance the taste of (food or drink) by adding a particular ingredient
groups.notes: 对食物使用时指添加配料以改变或增强味道；用于语气等时指赋予其某种特质。
groups.evidence: 例句8的鸡肉用香草调味，例句9用香料给食物调味，例句10说不耐烦的情绪影响了她的语气，均为动词 flavor。

examples.sentence: chunks of chicken flavored with herbs.
examples.translation_cn: 用香草调味的鸡肉块。

examples.sentence: they use a wide range of spices to flavor their foods.
examples.translation_cn: 他们用各种香料为食物调味。

examples.sentence: the faint exasperation that had flavored her tone.
examples.translation_cn: 她的语气中带着一丝不耐烦。

senses.definition_en: a mark, fault, or other imperfection that mars a substance or object

examples.sentence: plates with flaws in them were sold at the outlet store.

senses.definition_en: a fault or weakness in a person's character

examples.sentence: he had his flaws, but he was still a great teacher.

senses.definition_en: a mistake or shortcoming in a plan, theory, or legal document that causes it to fail or reduces its effectiveness

examples.sentence: there were fundamental flaws in the case for reforming local government.

senses.definition_en: (of an imperfection) mar, weaken, or invalidate (something)

examples.sentence: the computer game was flawed by poor programming.

senses.definition_en: a squall of wind; a short storm

examples.sentence: the ship had turned, caught in a windy flaw.

senses.definition_en: mistake, weakness

examples.sentence: there was a fatal flaw in their plan.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的计划有个致命错误

groups.definition_en: a mark, fault, or other imperfection that mars a substance or object
groups.notes: 指物质或物件表面的瑕疵。
groups.evidence: 例句1说有瑕疵的盘子被拿到折扣店出售，指物件的不完美之处。

examples.sentence: plates with flaws in them were sold at the outlet store.
examples.translation_cn: 有瑕疵的盘子被拿到折扣店出售。

groups.definition_en: a fault or weakness in a person's character
groups.notes: 可指人的性格弱点，也可指计划中的致命错误；例句3的 flaw 是使计划失效的根本缺陷。
groups.evidence: 例句2说老师虽有缺点仍是优秀教师；例句3说改革地方政府的理由存在根本缺陷；例句6说计划中有致命错误，均为抽象的弱点或错误。

examples.sentence: he had his flaws, but he was still a great teacher.
examples.translation_cn: 他有缺点，但仍然是一位出色的老师。

examples.sentence: there was a fatal flaw in their plan.
examples.translation_cn: 他们的计划有个致命错误

groups.definition_en: a mistake or shortcoming in a plan, theory, or legal document that causes it to fail or reduces its effectiveness
groups.notes: 指计划、理论或法律文件中削弱效果或导致失败的问题。
groups.evidence: 例句3中的改革方案理由存在根本缺陷，符合计划或论证中的问题；例句6也说计划有致命缺陷。

examples.sentence: there were fundamental flaws in the case for reforming local government.
examples.translation_cn: 地方政府改革的理由存在根本缺陷。

groups.definition_en: (of an imperfection) mar, weaken, or invalidate (something)
groups.notes: 可指瑕疵损害某物或使其失效。
groups.evidence: 例句4说糟糕的编程使电脑游戏存在缺陷，说明 flaw 作动词表示损害或削弱。

examples.sentence: the computer game was flawed by poor programming.
examples.translation_cn: 糟糕的编程使这款电脑游戏存在缺陷。

groups.definition_en: a squall of wind; a short storm
groups.notes: 旧式或少见用法。
groups.evidence: 例句5中船遭遇一阵大风，flaw 指短时强风。

examples.sentence: the ship had turned, caught in a windy flaw.
examples.translation_cn: 这艘船遇上了一阵猛烈的风。

senses.definition_en: run away from (someone or something)

groups.definition_en: an apparition of a dead person which is believed to appear or become manifest to the living, typically as a nebulous image
groups.notes: 可指被认为会显现在生者面前的死者形象，也可用于过去行为留下的幽灵般意象。
groups.evidence: 例句 “the building is haunted by the ghost of a monk” 中 ghost 是名词，指僧人的鬼魂；“the ghosts of past deeds” 也以名词指往事的幽灵般显现。

examples.sentence: the building is haunted by the ghost of a monk.
examples.translation_cn: 这栋楼里闹鬼，据说是一个僧人的鬼魂。

examples.sentence: the ghosts of past deeds.
examples.translation_cn: 过去所做之事的幽灵。

groups.definition_en: a faint trace of something
groups.notes: 可指微弱的痕迹或极少的可能性；a ghost of a chance 是“丝毫机会”。
groups.evidence: 例句 “she gave the ghost of a smile” 中 ghost 是名词，指一丝笑意；“I haven't a ghost of a chance” 和 “the ghost of a smile” 也分别表示丝毫机会和一丝微笑。

examples.translation_cn: 她勉强露出一丝笑容。

groups.definition_en: act as ghostwriter of (a work)
groups.notes: 指替他人撰写作品，通常不署自己的名字。
groups.evidence: 例句 “his memoirs were smoothly ghosted by a journalist” 中 ghosted 是被动动词，指回忆录由记者代笔。

groups.definition_en: (of a living thing) undergo natural development by increasing in size and changing physically; progress to maturity
groups.notes: 可指生物自然发育，也可指长成某种状态或阶段。
groups.evidence: “grown men”指长成的成年人；“She has grown into a beautiful young lady”指长成一位年轻女子。

examples.sentence: : the stupidity of grown men hitting a ball with a stick.
examples.translation_cn: 成年男子竟然拿着棍子打球，真是愚蠢。

examples.sentence: he would watch Nick grow to manhood.
examples.translation_cn: 他会看着尼克长大成人。

examples.sentence: She has grown into a beautiful young lady.
examples.translation_cn: 她长成一位年轻漂亮的女子。

examples.sentence: her hair had grown very long.
examples.translation_cn: 她的头发长得很长了

groups.definition_en: (of a plant) germinate and develop
groups.notes: 此义项专指植物发芽并生长。
groups.evidence: “seaweed grows in the ocean”说明海藻在海洋中生长。

examples.sentence: seaweed grows in the ocean.
examples.translation_cn: 海藻生长在海洋中。

groups.definition_en: produce by cultivation
groups.notes: 指培育作物、花卉等植物。
groups.evidence: “grow crops for export”及“We grow flowers and vegetables in our garden”均指种植植物。

examples.sentence: more and more land was needed to grow crops for export.
examples.translation_cn: 越来越多的土地被用于种植出口作物。

examples.sentence: We grow flowers and vegetables in our garden.
examples.translation_cn: 我们在庭园里种植鲜花和蔬菜。

groups.definition_en: allow or cause (a part of the body) to grow or develop
groups.notes: 可指身体部位自然长出，也可指使其生长。
groups.evidence: “she grew her hair long”是让头发留长；“the lizard grew a new tail”指蜥蜴长出新尾巴。

examples.sentence: : she grew her hair long.
examples.translation_cn: 她把头发留长了。

examples.sentence: the lizard grew a new tail.
examples.translation_cn: 蜥蜴长出了一条新尾巴

groups.definition_en: become larger or greater over a period of time; increase
groups.notes: 既可指数量、规模增加，也可指使业务或人数扩大；及物用法中的from…to…表示增长的起止数值。
groups.evidence: “turnover grew to more than $100,000”指营业额增长；“grow their businesses”指扩大业务；“the school grew from 400 to 900 pupils”指学生人数增加。

examples.sentence: turnover grew to more than $100,000 within three years.
examples.translation_cn: 营业额在三年内增长到十万多美元。

examples.sentence: entrepreneurs who are struggling to grow their businesses.
examples.translation_cn: 那些努力拓展业务的企业家。

examples.sentence: the queue is growing.
examples.translation_cn: 队列越排越长了

examples.sentence: the school grew from 400 to 900 pupils.
examples.translation_cn: 在校学生人数从400名上升到900名

groups.definition_en: become gradually or increasingly
groups.notes: 可指情绪增强、能力或艺术水平发展，也可指美貌、受欢迎程度增加。
groups.evidence: “we grew braver”指变得更勇敢；“grow as an artist”及“grown in popularity”指逐渐发展或提高。

examples.sentence: sharing our experiences we grew braver.
examples.translation_cn: 通过分享彼此的经历，我们变得更加勇敢。

examples.sentence: as I listened, my anger grew.
examples.translation_cn: 我越听越生气

examples.sentence: she continues to grow as an artist.
examples.translation_cn: 身为艺术家，她在不断成长

examples.sentence: she has grown in beauty/popularity.
examples.translation_cn: 她比以前更美丽/更受欢迎了

groups.definition_en: (of a person) come to feel or know something over time
groups.notes: 常用于表示经过一段时间逐渐产生某种感受或认识。
groups.evidence: “she grew to like the friendly, quiet people”表示她渐渐喜欢上那些友善安静的人。

examples.sentence: she grew to like the friendly, quiet people at the farm.
examples.translation_cn: 她渐渐喜欢上了农场里那些友善、安静的人。

groups.definition_en: become
groups.notes: 后接形容词，表示状态逐渐变化。
groups.evidence: “the weather is growing hot”表示天气渐渐变热。

examples.sentence: the weather is growing hot.
examples.translation_cn: 天越来越热

groups.notes: grow away from each other表示关系逐渐疏远。
groups.evidence: “they had grown away from each other”描述两人逐渐疏远。

examples.sentence: they had grown away from each other.
examples.translation_cn: 他们之间逐渐疏远了

groups.definition_en: arise out of
groups.evidence: “her scepticism grew from her early experiences”说明怀疑态度源于早年经历。

examples.sentence: her scepticism grew from her early experiences.
examples.translation_cn: 她怀疑的态度源于年少时的经历

groups.definition_en: change from
groups.notes: 可指城市、事物从较简单或较小的形态发展而来。
groups.evidence: “the city grew from a small village”表示城市由小村庄发展而来。

examples.sentence: the city grew from a small village.
examples.translation_cn: 这座城市是由一座小村庄发展起来的

groups.notes: grow into clothing指随着身体长大而穿得合身。
groups.evidence: “he'll grow into it”指他长大后会穿得合身。

examples.sentence: the coat's too big for him now, but he'll grow into it.
examples.translation_cn: 这件外套他现在穿太大，但他长高后可以穿

groups.notes: grow on someone表示某人逐渐觉得某事物更有吸引力。
groups.evidence: “the music was starting to grow on me”表示我开始渐渐喜欢这种音乐。

examples.sentence: the music was starting to grow on me.
examples.translation_cn: 我越来越喜欢听这种音乐了

groups.definition_cn: 逐渐不再有（某种习惯或行为）
groups.notes: grow out of表示随着成熟而不再有某种行为。
groups.evidence: “grow out of tantrums”指随着长大不再乱发脾气。

examples.sentence: most children grow out of tantrums by the time they're three.
examples.translation_cn: 多数孩子到三岁就不会乱发脾气了

groups.evidence: “bushes which had grown together”指灌木枝丛长到一起。

examples.sentence: a tangle of bushes which had grown together.
examples.translation_cn: 一团纠缠蓬乱的灌木

groups.notes: grow up指从童年成长为成年人，也可强调长大后的经历或成就。

groups.definition_en: the place where one lives permanently, especially as a member of a family or household

examples.sentence: the key to Jack's behavior may lie submerged in his unhappy past.
examples.translation_cn: 杰克的行为之谜，或许要从他不快乐的童年经历中寻找答案。

examples.sentence: Self-confidence is the key factor in any successful career.
examples.translation_cn: 自信是任何成功之道的关键因素。

examples.sentence: The quarterback was the key of their team.
examples.translation_cn: 那四分后卫是他们队的灵魂人物。

examples.sentence: This is the key to world peace.
examples.translation_cn: 这是世界和平的关键。

examples.sentence: the key to success/happiness.

groups.definition_en: a set of answers to exercises or problems

examples.sentence: a key at the back of the book provides the answers.
examples.translation_cn: 书后附有答案，可以查阅练习题的解答。

examples.sentence: The detective believes the missing gun is the key to the mystery.

examples.sentence: a key to the exercises.

examples.sentence: the key of D major/minor.

examples.translation_cn: 她成为妇女选举权运动中的一位关键人物。

examples.sentence: Self-confidence is the key factor in any successful career.
examples.translation_cn: 自信是任何成功之道的关键因素。

examples.translation_cn: 一名黑客将数据输入重要数据库后引发了混乱。

examples.translation_cn: 不是每个人都能又快又准确地录入数据。

examples.translation_cn: 随后，这些信息会被输入电脑。

groups.notes: 通过调整广告中的地址等形式，识别带来特定回应的刊物。

examples.sentence: one keys advertisements and measures returns.
examples.translation_cn: 人们会给广告做标记，并衡量其带来的回应。

examples.translation_cn: 有人可能会用钥匙刮坏你的车漆，而且不会受到惩罚。

examples.translation_cn: 我给咱俩泡两杯茶。

examples.sentence: she was making lunch for Lucy and Francis.
examples.translation_cn: 她正在为露西和弗朗西斯准备午餐。

examples.sentence: she made up a basket of food.
examples.translation_cn: 她弄好了一篮子食物

groups.definition_en: arrange bedclothes tidily on (a bed) ready for use
groups.evidence: 例句8中的 make your bed 指整理床铺。

examples.sentence: after breakfast you'd have until 8:25 to make your bed.
examples.translation_cn: 早餐后，你可以整理床铺，直到8点25分。

groups.definition_en: cause (something) to exist or come about; bring about
groups.notes: 可指造成具体结果或使某物出现。
groups.evidence: 例句9中滴水在地板上形成水洼；例句45中石块在车上砸出凹痕。

examples.sentence: the drips had made a pool on the floor.
examples.translation_cn: 滴水在地板上形成了一个水洼。

examples.sentence: the stone made a dent in the car.
examples.translation_cn: 石块把汽车砸出了一个坑

groups.definition_en: cause to become or seem
groups.notes: make someone/something + 形容词表示使其处于某种状态；make someone/something + 名词表示使其成为某种身份或角色。
groups.evidence: 例句10中装饰使砖砌结构更有趣；例句47中 make it clear 表示使事情明确；例句49中 make London our base 表示把伦敦作为基地；例句51、52中 make 表示使外观或声音显得某种样子。

examples.sentence: decorative features make brickwork more interesting.
examples.translation_cn: 装饰性细节使砖砌结构更有趣。

examples.sentence: the best way to disarm your critics is to make them laugh.
examples.translation_cn: 瓦解批评者的最好办法就是逗他们发笑。

examples.sentence: she made it clear we were not welcome.
examples.translation_cn: 她明确表示我们不受欢迎

examples.sentence: there's no point making yourself miserable about it.
examples.translation_cn: 没必要为这件事苦恼

examples.sentence: we'll make London our base.
examples.translation_cn: 我们要把伦敦作为大本营

examples.sentence: we'll make a soldier of you yet!
examples.translation_cn: 我们会把你锻造成为一名战士！

examples.sentence: it makes me look fat/ill.
examples.translation_cn: 它让我显胖/看上去像生病了

examples.sentence: the recording/tape made her voice sound strange/funny.
examples.translation_cn: 录音/录音带使她的声音听起来很怪/滑稽

examples.sentence: you've made his nose too big!
examples.translation_cn: 你把他的鼻子画得太大了！

groups.definition_en: carry out, perform, or produce (a specified action, movement, or sound)
groups.notes: 可指发表演讲、犯错、达成交易等具体行为；make a fuss 指大惊小怪。
groups.evidence: 例句12中 made a speech 是发表演讲；例句13中 make a mistake 是犯错；例句14中 made a deal 是达成交易；例句71中 making a fuss 是大惊小怪。

examples.sentence: Unger made a speech of forty minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 昂格尔发表了长达40分钟的演讲。

examples.sentence: anyone can make a mistake.
examples.translation_cn: 任何人都可能犯错。

examples.sentence: we made a deal.
examples.translation_cn: 我们达成了一项协议。

examples.sentence: stop making a fuss!
examples.translation_cn: 别闹了！

groups.definition_en: communicate or express (an idea, request, or requirement)
groups.notes: 用于提出要求、请求或报价等。
groups.evidence: 例句15中 make him an offer 是向他提出条件；例句16中 make demands 是提出要求。

examples.sentence: : make him an offer he can't refuse.
examples.translation_cn: 给他开出一个让他无法拒绝的条件。

examples.sentence: I tend to make heavy demands on people.
examples.translation_cn: 我往往对别人要求很高。

groups.definition_en: enter into a contract of (marriage)
groups.notes: 常见于 a marriage made in heaven，形容婚姻美满般天作之合。
groups.evidence: 例句17中的 marriage made in heaven 使用缔结婚姻的含义。

examples.sentence: a marriage made in heaven.
examples.translation_cn: 一桩天作之合的婚姻。

groups.definition_en: appoint or designate (someone) to a position
groups.notes: 用于任命或达到某一军衔、职位。
groups.evidence: 例句18中 he was made a colonel 是被任命为上校；例句31中 make captain 指成为队长。

examples.sentence: he was made a colonel in the Mexican army.
examples.translation_cn: 他被任命为墨西哥军队的上校。

examples.sentence: he wasn't going to make captain.
examples.translation_cn: 他不打算当队长。

groups.definition_en: represent or cause to appear in a specified way
groups.notes: 用于评估或呈现价值、性质。
groups.evidence: 例句19中价格和保修使商品显得物有所值。

examples.sentence: the sale price and extended warranty make it an excellent value.
examples.translation_cn: 折后价加上延长保修期，使它显得物超所值。

groups.definition_en: cause or ensure the success or advancement of
groups.notes: 可指某作品使某人声名鹊起。
groups.evidence: 例句20中作品 made Wordsworth's reputation 指成就其声誉。

examples.sentence: the work which really made Wordsworth's reputation.
examples.translation_cn: 正是这部作品成就了华兹华斯的声誉。

groups.definition_en: compel (someone) to do something
groups.notes: 可指促使某人去做某事；make someone do 表示强迫，make someone see 表示设法使其明白或采取行动。
groups.evidence: 例句21中 made me drink 是迫使喝酒；例句54中 make her see a doctor 是让她去看医生；例句55至57中 made、making someone do/talk 表示迫使或设法使其行动。

examples.sentence: she bought me a brandy and made me drink it.
examples.translation_cn: 她给我买了杯白兰地，逼我喝下去。

examples.sentence: you must make her see a doctor.
examples.translation_cn: 你一定要让她去看医生

examples.sentence: he must be made to cooperate.
examples.translation_cn: 必须逼他合作

examples.sentence: they made me (do it).
examples.translation_cn: 他们强迫我（这么做）

examples.sentence: we have ways of making you talk.
examples.translation_cn: 我们有办法让你开口

groups.definition_en: constitute; amount to
groups.notes: 可指若干部分构成整体、数量相加所得，也可指人组成一对或组合。
groups.evidence: 例句22中两人组成不同寻常的组合；例句62中一百厘米等于一米；例句63中这是第三次；例句64中新郎新娘组成一对。

examples.sentence: they made an unusual duo.
examples.translation_cn: 他们组成了一个不同寻常的二人组合。

examples.sentence: One hundred centimeters make one meter.
examples.translation_cn: 一百公分等于一公尺。

examples.sentence: that makes the third time I've asked you not to do that!
examples.translation_cn: 这已经是我第三次叫你不要做这事了！

examples.sentence: the bride and groom made a handsome couple.
examples.translation_cn: 新娘和新郎是完美的一对

groups.definition_en: serve as or become through development or adaptation
groups.notes: 可指适合成为某种事物、充当某种用途，或使整体效果出色。
groups.evidence: 例句23中蕨类植物适合作室内盆栽；例句58、59、60中分别成为好妻子、好礼物或好吃的食物；例句61中山洞充当庇护所；例句70、78中美酒或红玫瑰成就餐食或画面效果。

examples.sentence: this fern makes a good houseplant.
examples.translation_cn: 这种蕨类植物很适合作室内盆栽。

examples.sentence: She will make a good wife.
examples.translation_cn: 她会成为一个好妻子。

examples.sentence: that would make a good present.
examples.translation_cn: 这会是很好的礼物

examples.sentence: these apples make good eating.
examples.translation_cn: 这些苹果很好吃

examples.sentence: the cave made an excellent shelter.
examples.translation_cn: 山洞成了极好的隐蔽处

examples.sentence: a good wine can make a meal.
examples.translation_cn: 美酒可抵佳肴

examples.sentence: those red roses make for a wonderful display against the yellow background.
examples.translation_cn: 红玫瑰在黄色背景的衬托下显得非常好看

groups.definition_en: consider to be; estimate as
groups.notes: make it + 数量可表示估算或认为总数为某数。
groups.evidence: 例句24中 I make it sixteen 是估计共有十六个。

examples.sentence: How many are there? I make it sixteen.
examples.translation_cn: 有多少个？——我数是十六个。

groups.definition_en: gain or earn (money or profit)
groups.notes: 可指收入或交易利润。
groups.evidence: 例句25中 made money 指赚到钱；例句65中交易使他赚得500英镑。

examples.sentence: he'd made a lot of money out of hardware.
examples.translation_cn: 他靠经营五金赚了很多钱。

examples.sentence: the deal should make him £500, he should make £500 on the deal.
examples.translation_cn: 这笔交易能让他赚500英镑

groups.definition_en: arrive at (a place) within a specified time or in time for (a train or other transport)
groups.notes: 可指及时抵达地点或赶上交通工具；车辆 make a speed 指达到该速度。
groups.evidence: 例句26中 make it on time 指及时到达；例句27中 make the shuttle 指赶上接驳车；例句68中赶上末班车；例句69中汽车勉强达到每小时100英里。

examples.sentence: they didn't always make it on time.
examples.translation_cn: 他们并不总能准时赶到。

examples.sentence: we've got a lot to do if you're going to make the shuttle.
examples.translation_cn: 如果你要赶上接驳车，我们还有很多事要做。

examples.sentence: We just made the last bus.
examples.translation_cn: 我们正好赶上末班公车。

examples.sentence: the car can just make 100 mph.
examples.translation_cn: 这辆汽车勉强每小时能开100英里

groups.definition_en: succeed in something; become successful
groups.notes: make it 常指取得成功。
groups.evidence: 例句28中乐队 make it 指获得成功。

examples.sentence: he waited confidently for his band to make it.
examples.translation_cn: 他信心十足地等着自己的乐队取得成功。

groups.definition_en: achieve a place in
groups.notes: 可指进入新闻报道或晋级某一轮次。
groups.evidence: 例句29中进入新闻报道；例句30中晋级半决赛。

examples.sentence: these dogs seldom make the news.
examples.translation_cn: 这些狗很少登上新闻。

examples.sentence: they made it to the semifinals.
examples.translation_cn: 他们打进了半决赛。

groups.definition_en: go or prepare to go in a particular direction
groups.notes: 常与 toward(s) 连用，表示朝某方向移动。
groups.evidence: 例句32中 made toward the car；例句75中 made towards the door，均表示朝某处走去。

examples.sentence: he struggled to his feet and made toward the car.
examples.translation_cn: 他挣扎着站起来，朝汽车走去。

examples.sentence: she made towards the door.
examples.translation_cn: 她朝门走去

groups.definition_en: act as if one is about to perform an action
groups.notes: make as if/to 或 make like 表示做出即将采取某行动的样子。
groups.evidence: 例句33中 made as if to leave；例句72至74中 made like/as if to stab、kiss，均是做出仿佛要行动的样子。

examples.sentence: she made as if to leave the room.
examples.translation_cn: 她摆出要离开房间的样子。

examples.sentence: he made like he was injured.
examples.translation_cn: 他装作受伤了

examples.sentence: he made like to stab him.
examples.translation_cn: 他仿佛要刺他

examples.sentence: she made as if to kiss him.
examples.translation_cn: 她假装要亲吻他

groups.definition_en: induce (someone) to have sex with one
groups.notes: 口语且粗俗；make out with 可表示与某人发生性关系。
groups.evidence: 例句34、35中的 make someone/it with someone，以及例句86中的 make out with her，均指与人发生性关系。

examples.sentence: he had been trying to make Cynthia for two years now.
examples.translation_cn: 他已经试图和辛西娅上床两年了。

examples.sentence: his alleged quest to make it with the world's most attractive women.
examples.translation_cn: 他声称自己想和世界上最有魅力的女人上床。

examples.sentence: did you make out with her?
examples.translation_cn: 你和她做过爱吗？

groups.definition_en: the manufacturer or trade name of a particular product
groups.notes: 指产品制造商或品牌，常用于询问汽车的牌子。
groups.evidence: 例句36中的 make, model 指汽车厂牌、型号；例句76、77直接询问汽车的 make。

examples.sentence: the make, model, and year of his car.
examples.translation_cn: 他那辆车的厂牌、型号和年份。

examples.sentence: What make is your car?
examples.translation_cn: 你的汽车是什么型号？

examples.sentence: what make is your new car?
examples.translation_cn: 你的新车是什么牌子的？

groups.notes: 纸牌游戏用语。
groups.evidence: 例句66中 made her ten of hearts 指用红桃十赢得一墩。

examples.sentence: she made her ten of hearts.
examples.translation_cn: 她以一个红桃10赢了一墩牌

groups.notes: 常以距离或进度为宾语。
groups.evidence: 例句67中三小时只走了五英里。

examples.sentence: the road was hard going — we made only 5 miles in 3 hours.
examples.translation_cn: 路很难走，我们3小时才走了5英里

groups.notes: make off 表示迅速离开。
groups.evidence: 例句79中 made off across the main road 指匆忙穿过主干道离开。

examples.sentence: they made off across the main road.
examples.translation_cn: 他们连忙穿过主干道

groups.notes: make off with 表示偷走并带走某物。
groups.evidence: 例句80中 thieves made off with our jewellery 指盗贼偷走珠宝。

examples.sentence: thieves made off with our jewellery.
examples.translation_cn: 盗贼偷走了我们的珠宝

groups.notes: make oneself out to be 表示自称具有某种身份或特质。
groups.evidence: 例句81中 he makes himself out to be richer 指他把自己说得比实际更有钱。

examples.sentence: he makes himself out to be richer than he really is.
examples.translation_cn: 他夸口说自己很有钱，其实没那么富

groups.notes: make someone out 可表示弄明白某人的性格或意图。
groups.evidence: 例句82中 I can't make him out 表示弄不懂他。

examples.sentence: I can't make him out.
examples.translation_cn: 我搞不懂他

groups.notes: make out a case 表示提出并阐明一套理由。
groups.evidence: 例句83中 made out a good case 指充分阐明要求大赦的理由。

examples.sentence: he made out a good case for an amnesty.
examples.translation_cn: 他提出了充分的理由要求大赦

groups.notes: make out 可询问近况或与某人相处得如何。
groups.evidence: 例句84询问过得如何；例句85询问与家人相处得如何。

examples.sentence: how are you making out?
examples.translation_cn: 你过得怎样？

examples.sentence: how did you make out with his family?
examples.translation_cn: 你和他的家人相处得怎么样？

groups.notes: make over into 表示将某物改建或改作他用。
groups.evidence: 例句87中车库被改作书房。

examples.sentence: the garage has been made over into a study.
examples.translation_cn: 车库被改成了书房

groups.notes: make it up to someone 指补偿某人；make up lost wages 指补回损失的收入。
groups.evidence: 例句90、91分别表示补偿某人和补回工资损失。

examples.sentence: I'll make it up to you.
examples.translation_cn: 我会给你补偿的

examples.sentence: he made up his lost wages by working overtime.
examples.translation_cn: 他通过加班来补回损失的工资

groups.notes: make up 可指缝制衣物。
groups.evidence: 例句93中 making up an outfit 指缝制一套衣服。

examples.sentence: she was making up an outfit for the wedding.
examples.translation_cn: 她正在缝制一套结婚礼服

groups.notes: make it up 可表示即兴编造。
groups.evidence: 例句94中 making it up as I went along 指边做边编造。

examples.sentence: I was just making it up as I went along.
examples.translation_cn: 我只是在顺口编造

groups.notes: 口语命令 make with the money 要求对方马上交钱。
groups.evidence: 例句95中的 make with the money 是催促立刻交钱。

examples.sentence: make with the money!
examples.translation_cn: 快给钱！

senses.definition_cn: 涂在脸上的化妆品，如口红或粉末，用于改善或改变外观
senses.definition_en: cosmetics such as lipstick or powder applied to the face, used to enhance or alter the appearance

examples.sentence: she came downstairs, her face still white under her heavy makeup.
examples.translation_cn: 她下楼时，浓妆之下的脸依然苍白。

senses.definition_en: the composition or constitution of something

examples.sentence: studying the makeup of ocean sediments.
examples.translation_cn: 研究海洋沉积物的组成。

senses.definition_cn: 构成一个人性情的各种特质组合
senses.definition_en: the combination of qualities that form a person's temperament

examples.sentence: a nastiness that had long been in his makeup.
examples.translation_cn: 刻薄是他性格中根深蒂固的一部分。

senses.definition_cn: 为缺考或未通过原考试的学生补设的考试或作业
senses.definition_en: a supplementary test or assignment given to a student who missed or failed the original one

examples.sentence: : Tony has a makeup exam.
examples.translation_cn: ：托尼有一门补考。

groups.definition_en: cosmetics such as lipstick or powder applied to the face, used to enhance or alter the appearance
groups.notes: 可指涂在脸上的化妆品，也可指所化的妆。
groups.evidence: “she came downstairs, her face still white under her heavy makeup”中指浓重的脸部化妆品或妆容。

examples.sentence: she came downstairs, her face still white under her heavy makeup.
examples.translation_cn: 她下楼时，浓妆之下的脸依然苍白。

groups.definition_en: the composition or constitution of something
groups.notes: 指某物由哪些成分构成。
groups.evidence: “studying the makeup of ocean sediments”中指海洋沉积物的组成。

examples.sentence: studying the makeup of ocean sediments.
examples.translation_cn: 研究海洋沉积物的组成。

groups.definition_en: the combination of qualities that form a person's temperament
groups.notes: 指构成一个人性情的特质组合。
groups.evidence: “a nastiness that had long been in his makeup”中指根深蒂固的性格特质。

examples.sentence: a nastiness that had long been in his makeup.
examples.translation_cn: 刻薄是他性格中根深蒂固的一部分。

groups.definition_en: a supplementary test or assignment given to a student who missed or failed the original one
groups.notes: 指因缺考或未通过原考试而安排的补考或补交任务。
groups.evidence: “Tony has a makeup exam.”中指补考。

examples.sentence: : Tony has a makeup exam.
examples.translation_cn: ：托尼有一门补考。

senses.definition_en: of or denoting the sex that produces small, typically motile gametes, especially spermatozoa, with which a female may be fertilized or inseminated to produce offspring

examples.sentence: the participants are mostly male.

senses.definition_en: (of parts of machinery, fittings, etc.) designed to enter, fill, or fit inside a corresponding female part

examples.sentence: the valve has standard half-inch threaded male ends.

senses.definition_en: a male animal or plant

examples.sentence: the males have brilliant sky-blue wings.

senses.definition_en: a male person; a man or boy

examples.sentence: the audience consisted of adult males.

senses.definition_en: man, boy

examples.sentence: the average British male.
examples.translation_cn: 普通英国男子

groups.definition_en: of or denoting the sex that produces small, typically motile gametes, especially spermatozoa, with which a female may be fertilized or inseminated to produce offspring
groups.notes: 可指生物学上的雄性，也可指机械零件中用于插入或嵌合的凸端。
groups.evidence: “participants are mostly male”中指男性参与者；“threaded male ends”指带螺纹的公端。

examples.sentence: the participants are mostly male.
examples.translation_cn: 参与者大多是男性。

examples.sentence: the valve has standard half-inch threaded male ends.
examples.translation_cn: 这个阀门有标准的半英寸螺纹公端。

groups.definition_en: a male animal or plant
groups.notes: 指雄性动物或植物，也指男人或男孩。
groups.evidence: “the males have brilliant sky-blue wings”指雄性个体；“adult males”及“the average British male”指男性。

examples.sentence: the males have brilliant sky-blue wings.
examples.translation_cn: 雄性个体长着鲜艳的天蓝色翅膀。

examples.sentence: the audience consisted of adult males.
examples.translation_cn: 观众由成年男性组成。

examples.sentence: the average British male.
examples.translation_cn: 普通英国男子

examples.sentence: The whale is the largest mammal in all creation.
examples.translation_cn: 鲸是全世界最大的哺乳动物。

examples.sentence: Whales are mammals; fish are not.
examples.translation_cn: 鲸是哺乳动物；鱼则不是。

groups.evidence: 例句1称鲸为最大的“mammal”，例句2将鲸与鱼对比，均指哺乳动物。

examples.sentence: The whale is the largest mammal in all creation.
examples.translation_cn: 鲸是全世界最大的哺乳动物。

examples.sentence: Whales are mammals; fish are not.
examples.translation_cn: 鲸是哺乳动物；鱼则不是。

senses.definition_en: be in charge of (a company, establishment, or undertaking); administer; run

examples.sentence: their elder son managed the farm.

senses.definition_en: have the position of supervising (staff) at work

examples.sentence: the skills needed to manage a young, dynamic team.

senses.definition_en: be the manager of (a sports team or a performer)

examples.sentence: he managed five or six bands in his career.

senses.definition_en: administer and regulate (resources under one's control)

examples.sentence: we manage our cash extremely well.

senses.definition_en: maintain control or influence over (a person or animal)

examples.sentence: she manages horses better than anyone I know.

senses.definition_en: control the use or exploitation of (land)

examples.sentence: the forest is managed to achieve maximum growth.

senses.definition_en: succeed in surviving or in attaining one's aims, especially against heavy odds; cope

examples.sentence: Catherine managed on five hours' sleep a night.

senses.definition_en: succeed in doing, achieving, or producing (something, especially something difficult)

examples.sentence: : Beth finally managed to hail a cab.

examples.translation_cn: 这家公司销售各种家用器具。

groups.definition_en: a regular gathering of people for the purchase and sale of provisions, livestock, and other commodities
groups.notes: 可指交易商品的场所，也可泛指上市销售的去处。
groups.evidence: 例句1“farmers going to market”及例句11“shipped to market”均指市场这一交易场所或去处。

examples.sentence: farmers going to market.
examples.translation_cn: 农民们去集市。

examples.sentence: they wanted to browse around the market.
examples.translation_cn: 他们想在市场里逛逛。

examples.sentence: Strawberries are usually boxed before being shipped to market.
examples.translation_cn: 草莓通常装箱后再运往市场出售。

examples.sentence: The farmer carted his potatoes to the market.
examples.translation_cn: 那个农民用车把马铃薯运到市场。

examples.sentence: an antique(s) market.
examples.translation_cn: 古玩市场

groups.definition_en: an area or arena in which commercial dealings are conducted
groups.notes: 指某类商品、就业或金融交易领域及其交易状况；涉及股票时可特指证券市场。
groups.evidence: 例句3“the American market”、例句5“the market”及例句7“world markets”分别指商业领域、市场状况和股票市场。

examples.sentence: the sale of cruisers in the American market continues to plummet.
examples.translation_cn: 巡洋舰在美国市场的销量继续大幅下滑。

examples.sentence: the bottom's fallen out of the market.
examples.translation_cn: 市场已经崩盘。

examples.sentence: future development cannot simply be left to the market.
examples.translation_cn: 未来的发展不能简单地交给市场决定。

examples.sentence: the sale of the company's shares on world markets.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司在全球各地证券市场出售股票。

examples.sentence: a rising market in shares.
examples.translation_cn: 上涨的股票行情

examples.sentence: the job/property market.
examples.translation_cn: 就业/房地产市场

examples.sentence: the tea market, the market in tea.
examples.translation_cn: 茶叶市场

groups.definition_en: a demand for a particular commodity or service
groups.notes: 指某商品或服务有买家、存在需求。
groups.evidence: 例句4“there is a market for ornamental daggers”和例句17“There's no market for these goods”均说明商品是否有销路。

examples.sentence: there is a market for ornamental daggers.

examples.translation_cn: 这些货物没有销路。

examples.translation_cn: 良好的汽车销路

groups.definition_en: advertise or promote (something)
groups.notes: 可指推广商品、提供商品出售或实际销售。
groups.evidence: 例句8“marketed under the name”指以某名称推广，例句9“market their lambs”与例句19“market their goods”指销售。

examples.sentence: the product was marketed under the name “aspirin.”
examples.translation_cn: 这种产品以“阿司匹林”的名称进行销售。

examples.sentence: sheep farmers are still unable to market their lambs.
examples.translation_cn: 养羊农户仍然无法卖出他们的羊羔。

examples.sentence: The farmers are forming a combination to market their goods at fair prices.
examples.translation_cn: 农场主结成联盟，以便用合理的价格销售货物。

examples.sentence: The firm markets various kinds of household appliances.
examples.translation_cn: 这家公司销售各种家用器具。

groups.notes: marketing 在此指到市场购买食品或日用品。
groups.evidence: 例句10“do their marketing early”中的 marketing 是名词，指采购活动。

examples.sentence: : some people liked to do their marketing very early in the morning.
examples.translation_cn: 有些人喜欢一大清早就去采购。

groups.definition_en: (of a parent or guardian) give (a son or daughter) in marriage
groups.notes: 义项9的marry off强调安排某人结婚，例句中是把女儿嫁出去。
groups.evidence: “her parents married her to a wealthy landowner”表示父母把她嫁给富有的地主；“marry her off”也表示为她安排婚姻。

groups.definition_en: cause to meet or fit together; combine
groups.notes: 可指把不同事物结合，或使部分拼合在一起。
groups.evidence: “marries poetry with art”把诗歌与艺术结合；“the two halves are trimmed and married up”表示把两半修整后拼合。

examples.sentence: the show marries poetry with art.
examples.translation_cn: 这场演出将诗歌与艺术结合起来。

examples.sentence: the two halves are trimmed and married up.
examples.translation_cn: 两半经过修整后拼合在一起。

groups.definition_en: meet or blend with something
groups.notes: 常指食物或风味彼此搭配协调。
groups.evidence: “Chardonnays don't marry well with salmon”表示霞多丽葡萄酒与鲑鱼不太相配。

examples.sentence: most Chardonnays don't marry well with salmon.
examples.translation_cn: 大多数霞多丽葡萄酒都不太适合搭配鲑鱼。

groups.definition_en: an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times
groups.notes: 通常指低洼、长期积水的湿地；也可泛指沼泽地。

examples.translation_cn: 她是那种能迅速整理思路并清晰表达出来的人。

examples.translation_cn: 学校的教务长担任毕业典礼的司仪。

groups.definition_en: arrange or assemble (a group of people, especially soldiers) in order
groups.notes: 可指集结人群或部队，也可指有条理地汇集事实、想法等。

groups.definition_en: usher

examples.sentence: The foreign visitor was marshaled into the presence of the minister.

groups.notes: 可指联邦法院执行官、市司法官、警察局长或消防队长，具体职务因地区而异。
groups.evidence: 例句7中 marshal 将说话者带入法庭，语境指法院执行官。

examples.sentence: I was led into the courtroom by a marshal.

groups.notes: 此处为高尔夫比赛中负责组织或协助赛事的工作人员。

examples.sentence: It is unusual for a golfer to batter one of the marshals with his putter.

examples.sentence: A liter of gas has less mass than a liter of water.

groups.evidence: “goats can eat more or less any plant material”和“Wood and stone are the only raw materials on the island”均指物质材料。

examples.sentence: goats can eat more or less any plant material.
examples.translation_cn: 山羊几乎什么植物都能吃。

examples.sentence: materials such as brass.
examples.translation_cn: 例如黄铜等材料。

examples.sentence: Wood and stone are the only raw materials on the island.

examples.translation_cn: 天然材料制成的衣服

groups.definition_en: a person of a specified quality or suitability
groups.notes: 常用于某种资格、职业或活动的适合人选，如“上大学的料”。
groups.evidence: “he's not really Olympic material”和“he is (not) university material”都指适合某项目或去向的人选。

examples.sentence: he's not really Olympic material.
examples.translation_cn: 他确实不太够格参加奥运会。

examples.sentence: he is (not) university material.
examples.translation_cn: 他（不）是上大学的料

groups.definition_en: facts, information, or ideas for use in creating a book or other work
groups.notes: 可指创作所用的事实、信息或想法，也可指作品、演出中的内容。
groups.evidence: “there is much good material here for priests to use in sermons”指可用于布道的素材；“promotional/publicity/reference material”指资料，“the material in the magazine”指杂志内容，“a band playing original material”指乐队演出的原创作品。

examples.sentence: there is much good material here for priests to use in sermons.
examples.translation_cn: 这里有很多很好的素材，牧师可以用来布道。

examples.sentence: a band playing original material.
examples.translation_cn: 一个乐队正在演奏原创作品。

examples.sentence: promotional/publicity/reference material.
examples.translation_cn: 促销/宣传/参考资料

examples.sentence: the material in the magazine is controversial.
examples.translation_cn: 杂志内容有争议

groups.definition_en: cloth or fabric
groups.evidence: “a piece of dark material”中 material 指一块布料。

examples.sentence: a piece of dark material.
examples.translation_cn: 一块深色布料。

groups.definition_en: denoting or consisting of physical objects rather than the mind or spirit
groups.notes: 可表示物质层面的支持，也可指与身体需求或生活条件有关。
groups.evidence: “moral and material support”中与 moral 对举，指物质方面；“material living standards have risen”谈生活条件，material 为形容词。

examples.sentence: moral and material support.
examples.translation_cn: 道义和物质方面的支持。

examples.sentence: material living standards have risen.
examples.translation_cn: 物质生活水平提高了。

groups.definition_en: concerned with the matter of reasoning, not its form
groups.notes: 指推理内容方面的确定性，与形式层面相对。
groups.evidence: “political conflict lacks mathematical or material certitude”中 material 修饰 certitude，指内容或实质方面。

examples.sentence: political conflict lacks mathematical or material certitude.
examples.translation_cn: 政治冲突缺乏数学或实质上的确定性。

groups.definition_en: important; essential; relevant
groups.notes: 可指损害是否重大、事实是否与案件有关，或利益是否实质。
groups.evidence: “the insects did not do any material damage”中 material 指重大的；“information that could be material to a murder inquiry”及“of material benefit to the workers”中均为重要或有实质影响的形容词用法。

examples.sentence: the insects did not do any material damage to the crop.
examples.translation_cn: 这些昆虫并未对作物造成重大损害。

examples.sentence: information that could be material to a murder inquiry.
examples.translation_cn: 可能与谋杀案调查有关的信息。

examples.sentence: of material benefit to the workers.
examples.translation_cn: 对工人有实质利益的

groups.definition_en: fully developed physically; full-grown
groups.notes: 可指身体发育完全；用于作品等时指发展到成熟阶段。；用于人时指心理或情感发展充分，表现得明智懂事。；指作品或事物发展到最高或较晚阶段。；用于经济、行业或市场，指发展已趋成熟、扩张和投资空间有限。
groups.evidence: “owls are sexually mature at one year”指身体发育成熟；“the most mature of his plays”以同一成熟概念形容作品。；“a young man mature beyond his years”描述心理成熟；“a mature and sensible attitude”中的mature修饰态度，表示明智稳重。；“Van Gogh's mature work”指梵高成熟阶段的作品。；“a mature, sophisticated economy”以mature描述发展趋于成熟的经济体。

examples.translation_cn: 猫头鹰一岁时性成熟。

examples.sentence: she was now a mature woman.
examples.translation_cn: 她当时已经是个成熟的女人了。

examples.sentence: This is the most mature of his plays.
examples.translation_cn: 这是他最成熟的一部剧作。

examples.sentence: a mature and sensible attitude.

examples.sentence: Van Gogh's mature work.

examples.sentence: a mature, sophisticated economy.

groups.definition_en: combine or put together to form one substance or mass
groups.notes: 可指把成分混合成整体、将配料调制成某物，或不同物质相混合。
groups.evidence: 例句1、2中mixed表示香料或化学物质混合；例句3中mixing concrete表示调配混凝土；例句18中mixed him a bottle表示为他配药；例句19、20、21的mix表示油和水相混或不能相混。

examples.translation_cn: 这两种化学物质一旦混合，就会直接爆炸。

examples.sentence: mixing concrete is hard physical work.
examples.translation_cn: 搅拌混凝土是很费体力的工作。

examples.sentence: The doctor mixed him a bottle of medicine.

examples.translation_cn: 他仍将随意的幽默与敏锐的洞察力结合在一起。

groups.notes: 与人社交往来；可根据语境带有交友不当的含义。

groups.definition_en: (especially in sound recording) combine (two or more signals or soundtracks) into one

examples.translation_cn: 最多可以同时混合八条音轨。

examples.sentence: it took two years to mix his album.
examples.translation_cn: 制作他的专辑混音花了两年时间。

groups.notes: DJ将多段录音连接成连续的舞曲。

examples.translation_cn: 音乐声震耳欲聋，角落里有一位 DJ 正在混音、打碟。

examples.translation_cn: 装潢融合了古董与现代风格。

examples.translation_cn: 这所学校的学生群体构成多样。

examples.translation_cn: 用棉与涤纶混纺制成的裤子。

examples.translation_cn: 蛋糕预拌粉让烘焙变得更容易。

groups.definition_en: a version of a recording in which the component tracks are mixed in a different way from the original

examples.sentence: a dance mix version of “This Charming Man.”

groups.definition_en: a continuous piece of music, typically dance music, produced by combining a number of separate recordings

groups.definition_en: a feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, the achievements of those with whom one is closely associated, or from qualities or possessions that are widely admired
groups.notes: 可指因自身或相关者的成就、受赞赏的特质或事物而感到满足；也可指令人自豪的人或事物、某事物的鼎盛时期，以及相关的身份认同自豪。
groups.evidence: 例句“he takes great pride in his appearance”表示对自身仪表感到自豪；“the swimming pool is the pride of the community”指令社区自豪的事物；“in the pride of youth”指青春鼎盛时期；“a celebration of Latino pride”表示身份认同自豪。

examples.sentence: he takes great pride in his appearance.
examples.translation_cn: 他非常注重自己的仪表，并为此感到自豪。

examples.sentence: the team was bursting with pride after recording a sensational victory.
examples.translation_cn: 这支队伍取得惊人胜利后，个个都洋溢着自豪。

examples.sentence: the swimming pool is the pride of the community.
examples.translation_cn: 这个游泳池是社区的骄傲。

examples.sentence: in the pride of youth.
examples.translation_cn: 在青春最美好的年华里。

examples.sentence: a celebration of Latino pride.
examples.translation_cn: 拉丁裔自豪感庆祝活动。

examples.sentence: the bridge was lit up in rainbow colors, symbolic of LGBT pride.
examples.translation_cn: 这座桥被点亮成彩虹色，象征着LGBTQ群体的自豪感。

examples.sentence: the underlying theme of the song is black pride.
examples.translation_cn: 这首歌的深层主题是黑人自豪感。

examples.sentence: He has far too much pride.
examples.translation_cn: 他太自豪了。

groups.definition_en: consciousness of one's own dignity
groups.notes: 可指维护尊严的自尊，也可指家庭、民族等群体的自尊。
groups.evidence: “he swallowed his pride and asked for help”中的pride指自尊；“family/national/male pride”指群体或身份相关的自尊。

examples.sentence: he swallowed his pride and asked for help.
examples.translation_cn: 他放下自尊，开口求助。

examples.sentence: a false sense of pride.
examples.translation_cn: 一种虚假的自尊感。

examples.sentence: family/national/male pride.
examples.translation_cn: 家族自尊／民族自尊／男性自尊。

examples.sentence: pride alone prevented him from resigning.
examples.translation_cn: 他只是出于尊严而没有辞职

groups.definition_en: the quality of having an excessively high opinion of oneself or one's importance
groups.notes: 指对自己或自身重要性评价过高。
groups.evidence: “the sin of pride”与“puffed up with pride”都表示自负、傲慢。

examples.sentence: the sin of pride.
examples.translation_cn: 骄傲是七宗罪之一。

examples.sentence: puffed up with pride.
examples.translation_cn: 得意洋洋。

groups.definition_en: be especially proud of (a particular quality or skill)
groups.notes: 常用结构pride oneself on，表示以某种品质或技能为傲。
groups.evidence: “she'd always prided herself on her ability to deal with a crisis”中pride oneself on为动词结构。

examples.sentence: she'd always prided herself on her ability to deal with a crisis.
examples.translation_cn: 她一直以自己处理危机的能力为傲。

groups.definition_en: a public event, typically involving a parade, held to celebrate LGBTQ identities, culture, and experience
groups.notes: 指庆祝LGBTQ群体身份、文化与经历的公开活动。

examples.sentence: I went to pride as a teenager before I was ready to come out.
examples.translation_cn: 我十几岁时参加过骄傲节，那时我还没准备好公开自己的性取向。

examples.sentence: a pride of lions.

groups.definition_en: give new strength or energy to; reinvigorate

examples.translation_cn: 那场淋浴让她恢复了精力。

examples.sentence: I felt so refreshed after the rest.

groups.definition_en: stimulate or jog (someone's memory) by checking or going over previous information
groups.notes: 用于记忆时，指通过回顾信息帮助某人想起。

groups.definition_en: revise or update (skills or knowledge)

examples.sentence: short-term courses give nurses an opportunity to refresh their skills.

groups.definition_en: renew or update the display on (a screen)
groups.notes: 用于屏幕时，指更新显示内容；名词形式指屏幕显示更新这一动作或效果。

examples.sentence: refresh the screen frequently to make mistakes easier to identify.

examples.sentence: : a poor screen display which relies on scrolling refresh.
examples.translation_cn: 屏幕显示效果较差，依赖滚动刷新。

examples.sentence: a faster-running system with snappy screen refreshes.
examples.translation_cn: 运行速度更快的系统，屏幕刷新也更加迅捷。

groups.definition_en: place or keep (food) in cold water so as to cool it or maintain its freshness
groups.notes: 用于食物时，指放入冷水中使其冷却或保持新鲜。

examples.sentence: drain the eggs and refresh them immediately in cold water.

groups.definition_en: pour more (drink) for someone or refill (a container) with drink
groups.notes: 指给饮料容器续添饮料。

groups.definition_en: renew
groups.notes: 用于储备时指补充，用于形象等抽象对象时指更新或重塑。

examples.sentence: she looked all round the room.
examples.translation_cn: 她环视了整个房间。

examples.sentence: we've been travelling round France.
examples.translation_cn: 我们一直在周游法国

groups.definition_en: to fit in with
groups.notes: 将某人或某事作为组织生活的中心。
groups.evidence: “organize his life round the kids”表示以孩子为中心安排生活。

examples.sentence: he has to organize his life round the kids.
examples.translation_cn: 他不得不以孩子为中心来安排他的生活

groups.definition_en: in circular movement
groups.notes: 可指物体持续旋转，也可指周期性事件再次到来。
groups.evidence: “circled round overhead”“went round and round”“as summer comes round”分别体现旋转及周期循环。

examples.sentence: a plane circled round overhead.
examples.translation_cn: 一架飞机在头顶上盘旋

examples.sentence: the tune was going round and round in my head.
examples.translation_cn: 那支曲子一直在我脑海中回荡。

examples.sentence: what speed does the Earth go round at?
examples.translation_cn: 地球以什么样的速度旋转？

examples.sentence: The wheels went round and round.
examples.translation_cn: 轮盘旋转个不停。

examples.sentence: as summer comes round.
examples.translation_cn: 当夏天到来时

groups.definition_en: in circumference
groups.notes: 用于说明物体周边的尺寸。
groups.evidence: “a tree three metres round”表示树干周长为三米。

examples.sentence: a tree three metres round.
examples.translation_cn: 周长3米的一棵树

groups.definition_en: forming edge
groups.notes: 指围绕某物形成边界或包围。
groups.evidence: “a garden with a wall all round”表示花园四周都有墙。

examples.sentence: a garden with a wall all round.
examples.translation_cn: 有围墙的花园

groups.definition_en: here and there
groups.notes: 表示在某个地方各处散布或四处查看。
groups.evidence: “farms scattered round”“have a look round”分别指散布各处和四下查看。

examples.sentence: a large valley with a number of small farms scattered round.
examples.translation_cn: 有许多小农场散落其间的大山谷

examples.sentence: we could have a look round if you've got time.
examples.translation_cn: 如果你有时间的话，我们可以到处看看

groups.definition_en: in opposite direction
groups.notes: 依语境指方向相反或物体、家具的相对朝向和位置。
groups.evidence: “the wrong way round”“turn your chair the other way round”“which way round does it go?”都在判断或改变朝向。

examples.sentence: it's the wrong way round.
examples.translation_cn: 方向弄反了

examples.sentence: turn your chair the other way round.
examples.translation_cn: 把你的椅子转过去

examples.sentence: is this the right way round?
examples.translation_cn: 这是正确的路线吗？

examples.sentence: they've moved all the furniture round.
examples.translation_cn: 他们移动了所有家具的位置

examples.sentence: which way round does it go?
examples.translation_cn: 它通往哪一个方向？

groups.definition_en: changing direction
groups.notes: 指沿弯曲路线行进、绕远路或转到另一侧。
groups.evidence: “the road curved round”“the long way round”“walked round to the back”均描述改变路线或绕行。

examples.sentence: it was the last house before the road curved round.
examples.translation_cn: 过了这座房子，这条路就要拐弯了

examples.sentence: we had to drive the long way round.
examples.translation_cn: 我们不得不开车兜远路

examples.sentence: we walked round to the back of the house.
examples.translation_cn: 我们兜到房子后面

groups.definition_en: to various people
groups.notes: all round用于人群时表示每个人都如此。
groups.evidence: “there were smiles all round”表示在场的人个个都面带笑容。

examples.sentence: there were smiles all round.
examples.translation_cn: 每个人的脸上都露出了微笑

groups.definition_en: to office, work, home; at office, work, home
groups.notes: 口语中常指到访或身处某人的家、工作地点等。
groups.evidence: “be round at Joe's”“I'll be round in an hour”“she's coming round”都指到某处或来访。

examples.sentence: I'll be round at Joe's later.
examples.translation_cn: 过一会儿我会在乔那儿

examples.sentence: I'll be round in an hour.
examples.translation_cn: 我一小时后到

examples.sentence: she's coming round today.
examples.translation_cn: 她今天要过来

groups.definition_en: burst
groups.notes: 常指一阵掌声、欢呼等集体声音。
groups.evidence: “a round of applause/cheering”指一阵掌声或欢呼。

examples.sentence: a round of applause/cheering.
examples.translation_cn: 一阵掌声/欢呼

groups.definition_en: circular shape
groups.notes: 指切成圆形的片状食物或材料。
groups.evidence: “cut the pastry into rounds”中的rounds指切出的圆形酥皮块。

examples.sentence: cut the pastry into rounds.
examples.translation_cn: 把油酥面团切成圆块

groups.definition_en: of cheese; of meat
groups.notes: 用于牛肉时指一大块腿肉；用于奶酪时可指整圆形的一块。
groups.evidence: “a round of beef”指一大块牛腿肉；该义项英文定义也列出奶酪用法。

examples.sentence: a round of beef.
examples.translation_cn: 一大块牛腿肉

groups.definition_en: of sandwiches
groups.notes: 指一片通常切成圆形的三明治面包。
groups.evidence: “a round of ham sandwiches”指一份火腿三明治中的一片。

examples.sentence: a round of ham sandwiches.
examples.translation_cn: 一份火腿三明治。

groups.definition_en: slice of bread
groups.notes: round在此指一整片面包或吐司。
groups.evidence: “a round of toast”指一整片吐司。

examples.sentence: a round of toast.
examples.translation_cn: 一整片吐司面包

groups.definition_en: make round
groups.notes: 可将物体加工成圆形，也可收拢嘴唇形成圆唇姿势。
groups.evidence: “rounded chair legs”指把椅腿加工成圆形；“rounded his lips to whistle”指嘟起嘴唇。

examples.sentence: a lathe that rounded chair legs.
examples.translation_cn: 旋椅子腿的车床

examples.sentence: he rounded his lips to whistle.
examples.translation_cn: 他嘟起嘴唇吹口哨

groups.definition_en: finish off
groups.notes: round off表示为一段活动或行程增添收尾。
groups.evidence: “a dance to round off the evening”“rounded off the tour with a concert”都表示以某项活动为一天或行程收尾。

examples.sentence: a dance to round off the evening.
examples.translation_cn: 圆满结束晚会的舞蹈节目

examples.sentence: she rounded off the tour with a concert at Carnegie Hall.
examples.translation_cn: 她在卡内基音乐厅举行的音乐会圆满结束了这次巡回演出

groups.definition_en: make smooth
groups.notes: round off sharp edges或corners指去除尖角，使边缘平滑。
groups.evidence: “round off the sharp edges”“round off the corners with sandpaper”都指磨平尖锐边角。

examples.sentence: use a plane to round off the sharp edges.
examples.translation_cn: 用刨子刨平尖利的边沿

examples.sentence: you can round off the corners with sandpaper.
examples.translation_cn: 你可以用砂纸将角磨光

groups.notes: round on someone指突然转而愤怒地攻击或责骂某人。
groups.evidence: “she rounded on me angrily”中的round on表示突然愤怒地斥责说话者。

examples.sentence: she rounded on me angrily.
examples.translation_cn: 她突然对我大发雷霆

groups.definition_en: assemble
groups.notes: round up人或物时可指召集起来；用于警察或军队拘捕语境时指围捕。
groups.evidence: “rounded up a few friends”指召集朋友；“students were rounded up”指学生遭到围捕拘捕。

examples.sentence: I rounded up a few friends for a party.
examples.translation_cn: 我召集了几个朋友搞了个聚会

examples.sentence: thousands of students were rounded up when the military took power.
examples.translation_cn: 军队夺取了政权以后，成千上万的学生遭到拘捕

groups.definition_en: increase
groups.notes: round up指将数值提高到最近的整单位。
groups.evidence: “round the weight up to the nearest kilo”明确表示把重量进位至最近的整公斤。

examples.sentence: we'll round the weight up to the nearest kilo.
examples.translation_cn: 我们会把重量向上取整到最接近的整公斤。

senses.definition_en: bring out of sleep; awaken

examples.sentence: she was roused from a deep sleep by a hand on her shoulder.
examples.translation_cn: 她肩头被一只手碰了一下，从沉睡中醒来。

senses.definition_cn: 停止睡眠或不再处于不活跃状态；醒来
senses.definition_en: cease to sleep or to be inactive; wake up

examples.sentence: she roused and looked around.
examples.translation_cn: 她醒来后环顾四周。

senses.definition_cn: 使摆脱不活跃状态；使活跃起来
senses.definition_en: startle out of inactivity; cause to become active

examples.sentence: once the enemy camp was roused, they would move on the castle.
examples.translation_cn: 敌营一旦被惊动，他们就会向城堡进军。

examples.sentence: she'd just stay a few more minutes, then rouse herself and go back.
examples.translation_cn: 她会再待几分钟，然后振作起来回去。

senses.definition_en: cause to feel angry or excited

examples.sentence: the crowds were roused to fever pitch by the drama of the race.
examples.translation_cn: 比赛的戏剧性场面让观众群情激昂。

senses.definition_cn: 引起或激起（情绪或感受）
senses.definition_en: cause or give rise to (an emotion or feeling)

examples.sentence: his evasiveness roused my curiosity.
examples.translation_cn: 他的闪烁其词激起了我的好奇心。

senses.definition_cn: 搅动（液体，尤指酿造过程中的啤酒）
senses.definition_en: stir (a liquid, especially beer while brewing)

examples.sentence: rouse the beer as the hops are introduced.
examples.translation_cn: 加入啤酒花时搅动啤酒。

senses.definition_en: haul (something) vigorously in the specified direction

examples.sentence: rouse the cable out.
examples.translation_cn: 把缆绳朝外用力拖出来。

examples.sentence: He roused up from sleep.
examples.translation_cn: 他从睡梦中醒来。

groups.definition_en: bring out of sleep; awaken
groups.notes: 及物用法表示使人醒来；不及物用法表示从睡眠中醒来。
groups.evidence: 例句1中肩上的触碰使她从沉睡中醒来；例句2、9中 she、he 自己醒来，体现及物与不及物用法。

examples.sentence: she was roused from a deep sleep by a hand on her shoulder.
examples.translation_cn: 她肩头被一只手碰了一下，从沉睡中醒来。

examples.sentence: she roused and looked around.
examples.translation_cn: 她醒来后环顾四周。

examples.sentence: He roused up from sleep.
examples.translation_cn: 他从睡梦中醒来。

groups.definition_en: startle out of inactivity; cause to become active
groups.notes: 包括使营地警觉，以及使自己振作起来、采取行动。
groups.evidence: 例句3中敌营被惊动后将行动；例句4中她振作起来返回，均指脱离不活跃状态。

examples.sentence: once the enemy camp was roused, they would move on the castle.
examples.translation_cn: 敌营一旦被惊动，他们就会向城堡进军。

examples.sentence: she'd just stay a few more minutes, then rouse herself and go back.
examples.translation_cn: 她会再待几分钟，然后振作起来回去。

groups.definition_en: cause or give rise to (an emotion or feeling)
groups.notes: 可激起愤怒、兴奋等强烈反应，也可引发好奇等情绪或感受。
groups.evidence: 例句5中比赛使观众群情激昂；例句6中闪烁其词引起好奇，均为激发情绪或感受。

examples.sentence: the crowds were roused to fever pitch by the drama of the race.
examples.translation_cn: 比赛的戏剧性场面让观众群情激昂。

examples.sentence: his evasiveness roused my curiosity.
examples.translation_cn: 他的闪烁其词激起了我的好奇心。

groups.definition_en: stir (a liquid, especially beer while brewing)
groups.notes: 特指搅动液体，尤用于酿造啤酒时。
groups.evidence: 例句7要求加入啤酒花时搅动啤酒，体现字面搅动液体的用法。

examples.sentence: rouse the beer as the hops are introduced.
examples.translation_cn: 加入啤酒花时搅动啤酒。

groups.definition_en: haul (something) vigorously in the specified direction
groups.notes: 与方向副词连用，表示朝指定方向用力拖拉。
groups.evidence: 例句8的 rouse the cable out 指把缆绳朝外用力拖出。

examples.sentence: rouse the cable out.
examples.translation_cn: 把缆绳朝外用力拖出来。

senses.definition_en: a way or course taken in getting from a starting point to a destination

examples.sentence: the most direct route is via Los Angeles.

senses.definition_en: a method or process leading to a specified result

examples.sentence: the many routes to a healthier diet will be described.

senses.definition_en: send or direct along a specified course

examples.sentence: all lines of communication were routed through Atlanta.

senses.definition_en: path

examples.sentence: by a different route.

examples.sentence: on the route to Oxford.

senses.definition_cn: 常规路线、自行车道、航线

groups.definition_en: a number of people or things in a more or less straight line
groups.notes: 可指直线排列的人或物、座位排，也可指连续发生的次数；连续义见in a row。
groups.evidence: 第1项“a row of shops”、第2项“front row”及第11项“a row of cars”指一排；第12项“six times in a row”指连续六次。

examples.sentence: future additions will include a row of shops along the south side.
examples.translation_cn: 未来还将增设一些商店，沿南侧排成一排。

examples.sentence: her villa stood in a row of similar ones.
examples.translation_cn: 她的别墅位于一排类似的别墅中。

examples.sentence: the photograph shows a row of civilians walking between men in uniform.
examples.translation_cn: 照片中，一排平民在穿制服的人之间行走。

examples.sentence: they sat in the front row.
examples.translation_cn: 他们坐在前排。

examples.sentence: a row of cars.
examples.translation_cn: 一排汽车

examples.sentence: in the front row.
examples.translation_cn: 在前排

examples.sentence: seated in a row/in rows.
examples.translation_cn: 坐成一排/成排坐着

examples.sentence: six times in a row.
examples.translation_cn: 连续6次

groups.definition_en: propel (a boat) with oars
groups.notes: 可指用桨推动船、乘船航行、载人划船，也可指参加划船运动或比赛。
groups.evidence: 第3项“rowing a rubber dinghy”、第4项“rowed down the river”、第5项“rowing her across the lake”均指划船；第6项“rowed for Yale”和第13项“rows for Oxford”指代表学校参加划船运动。

examples.sentence: out in the bay a small figure was rowing a rubber dinghy.
examples.translation_cn: 海湾上有个小小的身影正在划一艘橡皮艇。

examples.sentence: we rowed down the river all day.
examples.translation_cn: 我们整天沿河划船。

examples.sentence: her father was rowing her across the lake.
examples.translation_cn: 她父亲划船载她渡过湖面。

examples.sentence: : she rowed stroke with the varsity eight.
examples.translation_cn: 她在校队八人艇中担任领桨手。

examples.sentence: he rowed for Yale.
examples.translation_cn: 他曾代表耶鲁大学参加划船比赛。

examples.sentence: he rows for Oxford.
examples.translation_cn: 他代表牛津大学参加划船比赛

groups.definition_en: a noisy acrimonious quarrel
groups.notes: 可指激烈争吵或较严重的公开争议。
groups.evidence: 第7项“they had a row”指两人争吵；第8项“a row over policy decisions”指围绕政策决定的争议。

examples.sentence: they had a row and she stormed out of the house.
examples.translation_cn: 他们吵了一架，她怒气冲冲地夺门而出。

examples.sentence: the director is at the center of a row over policy decisions.
examples.translation_cn: 主任正处于政策决策争议的中心。

groups.definition_en: a loud noise or uproar
groups.notes: 指响亮的吵闹或骚动声。
groups.evidence: 第9项“he must have heard that row”中row指前文所说的巨大喧闹声。

examples.sentence: if he's at home he must have heard that row.
examples.translation_cn: 如果他在家，肯定听见了那阵喧闹声。

groups.definition_en: have a quarrel

examples.translation_cn: 他们为卖掉东西所得的钱该归谁而争吵。

examples.sentence: Helen rowed with her boyfriend about a mere trifle.

examples.sentence: contributors included members of the royal family.

groups.definition_en: move one's hand or a cloth repeatedly back and forth on the surface of (something) with firm pressure
groups.notes: 可指来回擦拭、用手指揉擦，也可按语境指按摩或把膏剂等涂抹开。
groups.evidence: “rubbed at the dirt on his jeans”“rubbed a finger around the rim”体现反复揉擦；“rubbed my back”是按摩，“rub the cream into your skin”是把乳霜揉涂入皮肤，均为动词。

examples.sentence: : he rubbed at the dirt on his jeans.
examples.translation_cn: 他家人希望把他的骨灰撒在海里。

examples.sentence: she rubbed her arm, where she had a large bruise.
examples.translation_cn: 把椰蓉撒在糖霜上。

examples.sentence: he rubbed a finger around the rim of his mug.
examples.translation_cn: 沙滩上散布着漂流木。

examples.sentence: she rubbed my back.
examples.translation_cn: 她给我按摩后背

examples.sentence: rub the cream into your skin.
examples.translation_cn: 把润肤霜揉进皮肤里

groups.definition_en: (with reference to two things) to move or cause to move to and fro against each other with a certain amount of pressure and friction
groups.notes: 可指物体彼此摩擦，也可指身体部位相互摩擦发声。
groups.evidence: “insects make noises by rubbing parts of their bodies together”和“ice ... rub against each other”都描述物体或部位相互摩擦。

examples.sentence: : many insects make noises by rubbing parts of their bodies together.
examples.translation_cn: 沼泽地各处零星分布着许多磨坊。

examples.sentence: : the ice breaks into small floes that rub against each other.
examples.translation_cn: 吼声把狗群吓得四散奔逃。

groups.definition_en: (of shoes or other hard items in contact with the skin) cause pain through friction
groups.notes: 常用于鞋或其他硬物摩擦皮肤。
groups.evidence: “badly fitting shoes can rub painfully”中鞋摩擦皮肤并造成疼痛。

examples.sentence: badly fitting shoes can rub painfully.
examples.translation_cn: 他冲过门厅，把人群驱散了。

groups.definition_cn: 揉擦以使干燥、清洁、光滑或涂抹物质
groups.definition_en: make dry, clean, or smooth with pressure from a hand, cloth, or other object
groups.notes: 按语境可指擦干身体或头发、涂抹防晒霜，以及把油脂揉入面粉等混合物。
groups.evidence: “rubbing her hair”与“rubbed herself as dry as possible”是擦干；“rubbed some on her nose”是涂抹；“rub in the fat”是揉入食材。

examples.sentence: she found a towel and began rubbing her hair.
examples.translation_cn: 光线照射到悬浮在空气中的颗粒时发生散射。

examples.sentence: she rubbed herself as dry as possible.
examples.translation_cn: 费尔南德斯投出14次三振，同时在8局中只零星被敲出3支安打，未失分。

examples.sentence: she took out her sunblock and rubbed some on her nose.
examples.translation_cn: 北岸零星散布着几栋房屋。

examples.sentence: sift the flour into a bowl and rub in the fat.
examples.translation_cn: 零星散布的房屋／雨滴。

groups.definition_en: an act of rubbing
groups.notes: 指一次揉擦动作。
groups.evidence: “gave her head a quick rub”中的rub是一次擦揉动作，作名词。

examples.sentence: she pulled out a towel and gave her head a quick rub.
examples.translation_cn: 她拿出毛巾，迅速擦了擦头。

groups.definition_en: a difficulty, especially one of central importance in a situation
groups.notes: 常用于短语the rub，指出某情形中最关键的困难。
groups.evidence: “that was the rub”指这正是问题所在，rub作名词。

examples.sentence: that was the rub—she had not cared enough.
examples.translation_cn: 这正是难处——她当时并没有足够在意。

groups.definition_en: a mixture of spices and other seasonings that is applied to the surface of meat or fish before cooking
groups.notes: 指烹调前涂在肉或鱼表面的香料混合物。
groups.evidence: “a rub for a rack of lamb”指用于羊排表面的调味料混合物，作名词。

examples.sentence: he will be using coffee in a rub for a rack of lamb.
examples.translation_cn: 他会用咖啡做一种涂在羊排表面的调味料。

groups.notes: rub along表示在特定条件下勉强过得下去。
groups.evidence: “they rub along because their overheads are so low”中rub along表示勉强维持生活，是固定短语。

examples.sentence: they rub along because their overheads are so low.
examples.translation_cn: 他们勉强能生活，因为他们的日常开支很低

groups.notes: rub it in可指反复强调令人不快的事，或使人难堪。
groups.evidence: “rubbing it in how rich he is”表示反复炫耀，“no need to rub it in”表示不必再揭人痛处，均为短语用法。

examples.sentence: he's always rubbing it in how rich he is.
examples.translation_cn: 他总是爱说自己如何富有

examples.sentence: there's no need to rub it in!
examples.translation_cn: 没必要老是哪壶不开提哪壶！

groups.definition_en: come off
groups.notes: 可指墨迹因摩擦而沾染到别处，也可指粉笔或铅笔痕迹容易被擦除。
groups.evidence: “ink rubbed off on my hands”描述油墨擦脱并沾到手上；“chalk/the pencil rubs off easily”描述痕迹容易擦掉。

examples.sentence: the ink rubbed off on my hands.
examples.translation_cn: 油墨掉色沾到我手上了

examples.sentence: the chalk/the pencil rubs off easily.
examples.translation_cn: 粉笔/铅笔痕迹容易擦掉

groups.notes: rub off on sb指某种情绪或特质影响并传给他人。
groups.evidence: “your enthusiasm rubs off on him”表示热情感染他人，是固定短语。

examples.sentence: I hope your enthusiasm rubs off on him.
examples.translation_cn: 我希望你的热情能感染他

groups.definition_en: a contest consisting of a series of successive matches (typically three or five) between the same sides or people in tennis, cricket, and other games

examples.sentence: the opening rubber of Britain's Davis Cup tie against Argentina.

groups.definition_en: a unit of play in which one side scores bonus points for winning the best of three games
groups.notes: 在橡皮桥牌中，rubber 指三局两胜制中的一局；例句中的 winnings 是打橡皮桥牌所得。

examples.sentence: I loathe the smell of burning rubber.

examples.sentence: There are a lot of rubber plantations in this region.

examples.sentence: a rubber ball/hose.

groups.notes: 作定语描述由橡胶制成或与橡胶制造有关的物品；此义项没有英文定义。
groups.evidence: 例句“a rubber factory”中，rubber 修饰 factory，表示橡胶厂，实际作形容词。

examples.sentence: He works in a rubber factory.
examples.translation_cn: 他在一家橡胶厂工作。

groups.definition_en: waste material; refuse or litter

examples.sentence: an alleyway high with rubbish.

examples.sentence: she had to sift through the rubbish in every drawer.
examples.translation_cn: 她不得不翻找每个抽屉里的杂物。

examples.translation_cn: 我想你相信那些关于吸血鬼的胡说八道。

examples.sentence: (what a load of) rubbish!

groups.definition_cn: 严厉批评；斥为毫无价值

groups.evidence: 例句“rubbished professional estimates”中，rubbished表示贬斥并否定那些估算。

examples.sentence: he has pointedly rubbished professional estimates of the development and running costs.
examples.translation_cn: 他曾毫不留情地批评专业人士对开发和运营成本的估算。

groups.definition_en: very bad; worthless or useless
groups.notes: 常用于口语评价能力或表现很差。
groups.evidence: 例句“a rubbish manager”中，rubbish修饰manager，表示能力很差。

examples.sentence: people might say I was a rubbish manager.

examples.sentence: the war came as a very rude awakening.
