groups.evidence: 第5项“soft whispers”和第21项“soft music”都形容轻柔、不刺耳的声音。

examples.sentence: they spoke in soft whispers.
examples.translation_cn: 他们低声耳语。

examples.sentence: The soft music sounds very pleasing to the ear.
examples.translation_cn: 那轻柔的音乐听起来十分悦耳。

groups.definition_en: (of rain, wind, or other natural force) not strong or violent
groups.notes: 可形容风力较弱，也可形容气候温暖宜人。
groups.evidence: 第6项“a soft breeze”指轻柔微风；第20项“the soft climate”指温和气候。

examples.sentence: a soft breeze rustled the trees.
examples.translation_cn: 微风吹拂着树木，沙沙作响。

examples.sentence: He is used to the soft climate of the south.
examples.translation_cn: 他习惯于南方温暖的气候。

groups.definition_en: sympathetic, lenient, or compassionate, especially to a degree perceived as excessive; not strict or sufficiently strict
groups.notes: 可指富有同情心，也可指对人或犯罪不够严格，含过于宽容的意味。
groups.evidence: 第7项“Julia's soft heart”表示心软；“soft on crime”及第23项“You are too soft with them”表示宽容、不够严格。

examples.sentence: Julia's soft heart was touched by his grief.
examples.translation_cn: 朱莉娅心软，被他的悲伤打动了。

examples.sentence: the administration is not becoming soft on crime.
examples.translation_cn: 当局对犯罪问题并没有变得宽容。

examples.sentence: You are too soft with them.
examples.translation_cn: 你对他们太宽厚了。

groups.definition_en: (of words or language) not harsh or angry; conciliatory; soothing
groups.notes: 形容措辞或语气不尖锐、不愤怒，带安抚或缓和意味。
groups.evidence: 第8项“soft words”与第22项“soft and gentle words”均指温和、缓和的话语。

examples.sentence: he was no good with soft words, gentle phrases.
examples.translation_cn: 他不擅长说温和的话、说柔声细语。

examples.sentence: soft and gentle words.
examples.translation_cn: 温柔的话语

groups.definition_en: (of news or other journalism) regarded more as entertainment than as basic news
groups.notes: 用于新闻时指偏娱乐、生活方式等内容，不属核心时政或硬新闻。
groups.evidence: 第9项“soft news”明确将时尚新闻归为偏娱乐的新闻内容。

examples.sentence: fashion is regarded as soft news.
examples.translation_cn: 时尚被视为软新闻。

groups.definition_en: willing to compromise in political matters; moderate
groups.notes: 政治立场上较温和、愿意妥协。
groups.evidence: 第10项“soft left”指政治上的温和左派。

examples.sentence: candidates ranging from far right to soft left.
examples.translation_cn: 候选人从极右翼到温和左派都有。

groups.definition_en: not strong or robust
groups.notes: 常带有缺乏锻炼、体能欠佳的含意。
groups.evidence: 第11项“soft, out-of-shape executives”直接描述体型松软且缺乏锻炼的高管。

examples.sentence: soft, out-of-shape executives in a computer company.
examples.translation_cn: 某电脑公司的高管身体松垮，缺乏锻炼。

groups.definition_en: (of a drink) not alcoholic
groups.notes: soft drink指不含酒精的饮料。
groups.evidence: 第12项“soft drinks”以及第26项“something soft”都在饮料语境中表示不含酒精。

examples.sentence: all they had was ginger ale and a few other soft drinks.
examples.translation_cn: 他们只有姜汁汽水和几种其他不含酒精的饮料。

examples.sentence: would you prefer something soft?
examples.translation_cn: 你想喝点软饮料吗？

groups.definition_en: (of a market, currency, or commodity) falling or likely to fall in value
groups.notes: 形容价格、市场或货币疲弱、正在或可能下跌。
groups.evidence: 第13项“soft oil prices”及“the ruble, so soft”都表示价格或货币走弱。

examples.sentence: now a new factor looms: soft oil prices.
examples.translation_cn: 如今又出现了一个新因素：油价疲软。

examples.sentence: the ruble, so soft that it buys nothing worth having.
examples.translation_cn: 卢布如此疲软，几乎买不到任何像样的东西。

groups.definition_en: (of water) containing relatively low concentrations of dissolved calcium and magnesium salts and therefore lathering easily with soap
groups.notes: 指钙、镁盐含量较低，较易起泡的水。
groups.evidence: 第14项“soft water”及后面的肥皂用量说明符合软水含义。

examples.sentence: you use only half as much soap when you clean with soft water.
examples.translation_cn: 用软水清洗时，肥皂只需用一半。

groups.definition_en: foolish; silly
groups.notes: go soft in the head表示头脑变糊涂。
groups.evidence: 第15项“going soft in the head”是头脑糊涂的固定表达。

examples.sentence: he must be going soft in the head.
examples.translation_cn: 他一定是脑子糊涂了。

groups.definition_en: infatuated with
groups.notes: 常见结构为 be soft on someone，指对某人有好感或迷恋。
groups.evidence: 第16项“was Brendan soft on her?”使用soft on someone结构，询问是否迷恋她。

examples.sentence: was Brendan soft on her?
examples.translation_cn: 布伦丹是不是迷恋上她了？

groups.definition_en: softly
groups.notes: soft在此作副词，等于 softly。
groups.evidence: 第17项“I can just speak soft”中soft修饰动词speak，实际作副词。

examples.sentence: I can just speak soft and she'll hear me.
examples.translation_cn: 我只要轻声说话，她就能听见。

groups.definition_en: easy, agreeable
groups.notes: 形容工作容易、压力小；不表示工作体格轻松。
groups.evidence: 第24项“a soft and well-paid job”将soft与高薪并列，表示工作轻松。

examples.sentence: She's got a soft and well-paid job.
examples.translation_cn: 她的工作很轻松，报酬也很优厚。

groups.notes: 用于字母c时，指其发音如city中的/s/。
groups.evidence: 第25项“‘c’ is soft in ‘city’”明确讨论字母c的发音。

examples.sentence: ‘c’ is soft in ‘city’.
examples.translation_cn: c在city中发软音

examples.sentence: My job is writing the software.
examples.translation_cn: 我的工作是写软体。

examples.sentence: The software runs compatibly with many machines.
examples.translation_cn: 这个软体与许多机器兼容运行。

groups.notes: 指计算机程序及相关数据；“软体”是地区用语，此处按通行大陆译法作“软件”。
groups.evidence: 例句1“writing the software”指编写软件；例句2“software runs compatibly with many machines”指软件能与多种机器兼容运行。

examples.sentence: My job is writing the software.
examples.translation_cn: 我的工作是编写软件。

examples.sentence: The software runs compatibly with many machines.
examples.translation_cn: 这个软件能与许多机器兼容运行。

examples.sentence: the precise, spare movements of the dancers.
examples.translation_cn: 舞蹈演员们准确而简洁的动作

groups.definition_en: meager; nearly inadequate

examples.sentence: the furnishings were spare and unadorned.
examples.translation_cn: 家具陈设很少，也没有装饰。

groups.definition_en: an item kept in case another item of the same type is lost, broken, or worn out

examples.translation_cn: 确保所有轮胎都没问题，包括备用胎。

examples.translation_cn: 一套备用品

examples.sentence: have my pen: I've got a spare.

examples.sentence: take a spare (just in case).

groups.definition_en: give (something of which one has enough) to (someone); afford to give to
groups.notes: 可指抽出时间、提供物品或钱，也可指有余量、还有剩余。
groups.evidence: “spare her a dollar or two”指给她一些钱；“I can spare 5 minutes”指抽出时间；“with some to spare”指还有剩余。

examples.sentence: she asked if I could spare her a dollar or two.
examples.translation_cn: 她问我能不能给她一两美元。

examples.sentence: I can spare 5 minutes.
examples.translation_cn: 我能抽出5分钟

examples.sentence: I can spare £250 for Christmas presents.
examples.translation_cn: 我可以拿出250英镑买圣诞礼物

examples.translation_cn: 我可抽不出时间站在一旁跟你聊天！

examples.translation_cn: 我赶上火车时就剩几分钟了

examples.translation_cn: 我没力气/时间做家务

examples.sentence: can you spare a cigarette?

examples.sentence: can you spare me ten pounds?

examples.sentence: that turkey will feed ten people with some to spare.

examples.sentence: there's no time to spare!

examples.sentence: they won the match with something to spare.
examples.translation_cn: 他们赢了比赛，而且还绰绰有余。

groups.definition_en: make free or available

examples.sentence: I'm sure you can spare me a moment.
examples.translation_cn: 我相信你能腾出一点时间给我。

groups.definition_en: refrain from killing, injuring, or distressing
groups.notes: 可指不杀害、不伤害，也可指不砍伐或不遗漏。
groups.evidence: “there was no way the men would spare her”指不放过她；“spared a few trees”指留下几棵树未砍。

examples.translation_cn: 那些人绝不会放过她。

examples.sentence: the report spares no one.

groups.definition_en: refrain from inflicting (something) on (someone)

examples.translation_cn: 我就是不想让她受累

examples.translation_cn: 他捡回了一条命

examples.sentence: spare me the sarcasm.

examples.sentence: the north will be spared much of the bad weather.
examples.translation_cn: 这种糟糕的天气将基本不会出现在北方

examples.sentence: the surgeon spared him the knife.

examples.sentence: try to spare her as much distress as possible.

examples.translation_cn: 他不惜工本为自己造了一幢别墅。

examples.sentence: spare your pains: I've done it myself!

examples.translation_cn: 不过，有些人会花钱，有些人则会省下来。

groups.definition_en: manage without

groups.definition_en: store-bought
groups.notes: 常作名词前修饰语，表示商品在商店购买；源数据将其标为名词。
groups.evidence: 例句1中store修饰bread，构成store bread，表示商店售卖的面包，实际是名词作定语。

examples.sentence: there's a loaf of store bread.
examples.translation_cn: 有一条店售面包。

groups.definition_en: a quantity or supply of something kept for use as needed
groups.notes: 可指物质储备，也可比喻知识等积累。
groups.evidence: 例句2、3、8分别指知识储备、食物储备和丰富的知识积累，均为名词。

examples.sentence: her vast store of knowledge.
examples.translation_cn: 她有渊博的知识储备。

examples.sentence: the squirrel has a store of food.
examples.translation_cn: 松鼠有储备的食物。

examples.sentence: a vast store of knowledge.
examples.translation_cn: 丰富的知识储备

groups.definition_en: keep or accumulate (something) for future use
groups.notes: 可把物品留待以后使用；store up强调逐渐积累。
groups.evidence: 例句4、13–14、21、23均表示把家具、坚果、衣物或食物存放起来以备后用；例句5为头脑中储有知识。

examples.sentence: a small room used for storing furniture.
examples.translation_cn: 一间用来存放家具的小房间。

examples.sentence: a mind well stored with esoteric knowledge.
examples.translation_cn: 头脑中储有渊博而深奥的知识。

examples.sentence: the squirrels store nuts for the winter.
examples.translation_cn: 松鼠会为过冬储存坚果

examples.sentence: The cabbages were stored in the basement.
examples.translation_cn: 包心菜储藏在地下室里。

examples.sentence: those old clothes are stored away in the attic.
examples.translation_cn: 那些旧衣服存放在阁楼上

examples.sentence: animals were storing up food for the winter.
examples.translation_cn: 动物们在储备过冬的食物

groups.definition_en: remain fresh while being stored
groups.notes: 可表示物品储存期间能保持新鲜或良好状态。
groups.evidence: 例句6说明松露在冷藏条件下可以保存，实际为不及物动词；例句5是持有储备的及物用法，与此组并非同义，应归入储存组。

examples.sentence: they do not ship or store well.
examples.translation_cn: 它们不耐运输，也不易保存。

examples.sentence: these truffles will store for up to two weeks in the fridge.
examples.translation_cn: 这些松露在冰箱里可以存放两个星期

groups.definition_en: shop of any size
groups.notes: 泛指销售商品的商铺。
groups.evidence: 例句7中store是活动场景所在的商店，为名词。

examples.sentence: The store was a scene of great activity.
examples.translation_cn: 这家商店顾客盈门。

groups.definition_en: storage place
groups.notes: 指专门存放粮食、军火等物品的场所。
groups.evidence: 例句9的grain/munition store指粮仓或军火库，为名词。

examples.sentence: a grain/munition store.
examples.translation_cn: 粮仓/军火库

groups.definition_cn: 将来会发生的事；即将到来的事
groups.definition_en: storage
groups.notes: 固定搭配in store表示等待着（某人）的未来事物，常指意外或麻烦，并非“储存”。
groups.evidence: 例句10–11中trouble/surprise in store指未来等待着的麻烦或惊喜，store属固定搭配中的名词。

examples.sentence: it looks like there's trouble in store.
examples.translation_cn: 看起来好像会有麻烦

examples.sentence: they think it’ll be easy, but they have a surprise in store.
examples.translation_cn: 他们认为这很容易，但是他们会大吃一惊的

groups.definition_en: importance; value
groups.notes: 固定搭配set great store by表示非常重视。
groups.evidence: 例句12的set great store by your advice意为非常重视你的建议，整项为短语用法。

examples.sentence: he sets great store by your advice.
examples.translation_cn: 他非常重视你的建议

groups.definition_en: hold
groups.notes: 强调空间能够容纳某物。
groups.evidence: 例句15–16说谷仓能放下粮食、橱柜能放下书，store表示容纳。

examples.sentence: The barn will store five tons of grain.
examples.translation_cn: 这个谷仓能放五吨粮食。

examples.sentence: the cupboard can store all the books.
examples.translation_cn: 这个橱柜放得下所有的书

groups.definition_en: retain or enter (information) for future electronic retrieval
groups.notes: 指保存数据或电子文件以便日后取用；第18项例句的secrets stored away in his brain是比喻性的记忆储存。
groups.evidence: 例句17–18分别说数据存于磁盘、文件存于线上，以及秘密存在脑海中，均为动词store的保存义。

examples.sentence: the data is stored on disk.
examples.translation_cn: 数据存在磁盘上

examples.sentence: the service allows clients to store unlimited files online.
examples.translation_cn: 这项服务允许客户在线存储不限数量的文件。

examples.sentence: she wondered what secrets were stored away in his brain.
examples.translation_cn: 她想知道他的头脑中都藏了些什么秘密

groups.definition_en: retain mentally
groups.notes: 表示将信息留在记忆中。
groups.evidence: 例句19明确提到in my memory，store表示把日期记在脑中。

examples.sentence: I can't store these dates in my memory.
examples.translation_cn: 我记不住这些日期

groups.definition_en: bottle up
groups.notes: store up anger指压抑并积存愤怒，常暗示之后爆发。

examples.sentence: she had stored up all her anger and eventually snapped.
examples.translation_cn: 她把所有的愤怒都憋在心里，最后终于爆发了

examples.sentence: by ignoring your feelings, you are only storing up trouble for yourself.
examples.translation_cn: 你回避自己的感情问题，将来必有麻烦

groups.definition_en: very bad weather; with rain; with snow; with thunder and lightning
groups.notes: 具体天气现象；结合语境译作暴风雨、暴风雪或雷暴。
groups.evidence: “The ship had no sooner dropped anchor than a storm broke”及“the rain began to pour down”表明 storm 指恶劣天气。

examples.sentence: The ship had no sooner dropped anchor than a storm broke.
examples.translation_cn: 船刚下锚暴风雨就来了。

examples.sentence: The storm has abated.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨减弱了。

examples.sentence: the storm broke, and the rain began to pour down.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨降临了，大雨开始倾盆而下

groups.definition_en: controversy
groups.notes: controversy 用法指引发广泛关注或争论的事件。
groups.evidence: “Don't chance sailing in a storm”中 storm 指天气风暴；“at the center of a storm concerning payments”中指围绕付款问题的争议。

examples.sentence: Don't chance sailing in a storm.
examples.translation_cn: 别冒险在暴风雨中航行。

examples.sentence: she has been at the center of a storm concerning payments.
examples.translation_cn: 她一直处在一场有关付款问题的风波中心。

examples.sentence: the book caused a storm in South America.
examples.translation_cn: 这本书在南美引起了轩然大波。

groups.definition_en: outburst
groups.notes: 可指掌声、抗议等强烈而集中的反应。
groups.evidence: “a storm of applause”及“a storm of protest”均以 storm 比喻强烈反应；“raised a storm of protest”也体现此义。

examples.sentence: a storm of applause.
examples.translation_cn: 暴风雨般的掌声

examples.sentence: a storm of protest.
examples.translation_cn: 抗议的浪潮

examples.sentence: the disclosure raised a storm of protest.
examples.translation_cn: 这项披露引发了强烈抗议。

groups.definition_en: a heavy discharge of missiles or blows
groups.notes: 常见搭配 a storm of bullets，强调大量子弹密集袭来。
groups.evidence: “a storm of bullets”及“two men were taken by a storm of bullets”中 storm 指大量子弹形成的密集攻击。

examples.sentence: a storm of bullets.
examples.translation_cn: 枪林弹雨

examples.sentence: two men were taken by a storm of bullets.
examples.translation_cn: 两名男子在一阵密集的子弹扫射中被击中。

groups.notes: take a place by storm 表示迅速征服、风靡某地。
groups.evidence: “the play took London by storm”中 storm 构成固定表达，指该剧迅速风靡伦敦。

examples.sentence: the play took London by storm.
examples.translation_cn: 这部剧迅速风靡伦敦。

groups.definition_en: move angrily or forcefully in a specified direction
groups.notes: 常与 out 或 off 连用，突出带怒气的急促离开。
groups.evidence: “he stormed out of the house”及“stormed off”中 stormed 描写愤然离去。

examples.sentence: he stormed out of the house.
examples.translation_cn: 他怒气冲冲地冲出了房子。

examples.sentence: she burst into tears and stormed off.
examples.translation_cn: 她突然哭起来，随后气冲冲地走开了。

groups.definition_en: shout (something) angrily; rage
groups.evidence: “‘Don't patronize me!’ she stormed”及“‘don't you know who I am?’ she stormed”中 stormed 引出愤怒的话语。

examples.sentence: “Don't patronize me!” she stormed.
examples.translation_cn: “别用居高临下的口气对我说话！”她怒喝道。

examples.sentence: ‘don't you know who I am?’ she stormed.
examples.translation_cn: “你不知道我是谁吗？”她怒喝道

groups.definition_en: move forcefully and decisively to a specified position in a game or contest
groups.notes: 用于比赛语境，表示强势地冲向目标位置。
groups.evidence: “stormed to the checkered flag”中 stormed 表示奋力冲向终点旗。

examples.sentence: he barged past and stormed to the checkered flag.
examples.translation_cn: 他挤过人群，奋力冲向方格旗。

groups.definition_en: (of troops) suddenly attack and capture (a building or other place) by means of force
groups.notes: 可指部队或突袭人员以武力迅速攻入某地。
groups.evidence: “commandos stormed a hijacked plane”及“troops stormed into the city”都描述武力突袭。

examples.sentence: commandos stormed a hijacked plane early today.
examples.translation_cn: 突击队员今天清晨攻占了一架遭劫持的飞机。

examples.sentence: troops stormed into the city at dawn.
examples.translation_cn: 部队在拂晓时分攻入城内

groups.definition_en: (of the weather) be violent, with strong winds and usually rain, thunder, lightning, or snow
groups.notes: 天气动词，可按语境指雨、雪、雷电等恶劣天气。
groups.evidence: “it stormed in the day”及“it stormed last night”中 stormed 作天气动词，表示发生暴风雨或雷暴。

examples.sentence: it stormed in the day.
examples.translation_cn: 白天出现了暴风雨。

examples.sentence: it stormed last night.
examples.translation_cn: 昨夜雷雨大作

examples.sentence: he was about to sing.
examples.translation_cn: 他就要演唱了

examples.sentence: the youngest to enter the competition.

groups.definition_cn: 代替省略的不定式动词

groups.notes: 不定式用于表达强烈愿望。

groups.evidence: 例句1“diamonds and treasure”和例句2“art treasures”分别指财宝与珍贵艺术品；例句6已有译文“金银财宝”，对应同一名词核心。

groups.definition_en: behave toward or deal with in a certain way
groups.notes: 可指对待某人，也可指把某物视为某种性质或身份。
groups.evidence: 例句1–3、13–14中 treat 表示如何对待她、如何看待信息、如何讲授主题，以及把人当作成年人或把地方当作旅馆。

examples.sentence: he treated her with grave courtesy.
examples.translation_cn: 那位老人曾请他喝过一两杯酒。

examples.sentence: she had been brutally treated.

examples.sentence: stop treating this place like a hotel.

groups.definition_en: regard something as being of a specified nature with implications for one's actions concerning it
groups.notes: 常体现把某事归入某一类别并据此处理。
groups.evidence: 例句3中 names 被 treated as classified information，表示把姓名视为机密信息。

examples.sentence: the names are being treated as classified information.
examples.translation_cn: 这些姓名正被视为机密信息。

groups.definition_en: present or discuss (a subject)
groups.notes: 指对主题进行讲解或讨论。

groups.notes: 指给予医疗照护以治愈疾病或处理伤病。

examples.sentence: the two were treated for cuts and bruises.

examples.sentence: she's being treated for cancer.

groups.definition_en: apply a process or a substance to (something) to protect or preserve it or to give it particular properties

groups.evidence: 例句6、19–20中织物和木桩经处理或涂覆，以改变或改善其性质。

examples.sentence: linen creases badly unless it is treated with the appropriate finish.
examples.translation_cn: 亚麻布若不经过适当的整理处理，就很容易起皱。

examples.sentence: fence posts treated with creosote.

examples.sentence: the fabric's been treated to make it fire-resistant.

groups.definition_en: provide someone with (food, drink, or entertainment) at one's own expense

examples.sentence: the old man had treated him to a drink or two.

examples.sentence: We'll treat you to dinner.
examples.translation_cn: 我们请你吃饭。

examples.sentence: go on, have it, I'll treat you.

groups.definition_en: give someone (something) as a favor
groups.notes: 常用于 treat someone to something，指给某人某种特别的东西或举动。
groups.evidence: 例句8中 treat her to one of his smiles，表示给她一个微笑。

examples.sentence: he treated her to one of his smiles.
examples.translation_cn: 他给了她一个微笑。

groups.definition_en: do or have something that gives one great pleasure
groups.notes: 可指做令自己愉快的事，也可指给自己享受或奖励。
groups.evidence: 例句9中 treat yourself 指让自己享受一下。

examples.sentence: treat yourself—you can diet tomorrow.
examples.translation_cn: 犒赏一下自己吧——明天再节食。

groups.definition_en: negotiate terms with someone, especially an opponent
groups.notes: 常指与对手或敌方谈判。

examples.sentence: propagandists claimed that he was treating with the enemy.
examples.translation_cn: 宣传人员声称他正在与敌人谈判。

groups.definition_en: an event or item that is out of the ordinary and gives great pleasure
groups.notes: 可指特别令人愉快的活动、食物或惊喜；my treat 表示由说话者付账。
groups.evidence: 例句11–12、21–22中 treat 分别指看电影的特别享受、由说话者买单，以及令人愉悦的惊喜或美食。
